title_translated: 大型语言模型中的框架诱导脆弱性：来自中文新闻标题的证据
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于评估、路由和管理新闻，因此模型对新闻标题的判断已成为一种把关决策。我们探讨这种判断是基于所报道的事实，还是基于事实的表述方式。我们结合对63,926条中文新闻标题的生态审计与一项受控实验。实验涵盖30个真实事件、30个合成事件和29组自然标题对，测试了四个中文模型。仅改变标题的表述框架就显著影响了感知误导性和事件严重性，且变化的方向和顺序在DeepSeek、MiMo、Dots和LongCat模型中一致。情绪强化的标题使严重性评分提高0.65至0.88分，而正面重构的标题则使其降低0.34至0.52分。提供文章正文可减少54%至80%的严重性偏差，且所有减少均在p < .01水平上显著。一项小规模的人类对照研究也显示出相同方向的效果。因此，仅基于标题的LLM评估存在可测量的鲁棒性差距，框架敏感性应被视为部署与治理中需关注的可靠性属性之一。

summary: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. The factory searches from small to large models across base models and quantizations, adapts its accuracy goal as it searches, and uses real measurements of the target phone across inference engines and backends. We evaluate Mobile AI Factory on ten tasks and four Android phones. On an unseen testset, its on-device models outperform two five-shot frontier models on five tasks, by up to 0.34, and match them on three more. Its search comes within 0.03 of exhaustively training all 27 model variants on an entity extraction task, while using 19$\times$ less GPU time. Phone measurements also matter: the best configuration changes across phones. Without phone measurements, Claude Opus 5.5, given the full hardware and model specifications, misses the app's requirements in 25\% of easy and moderate cases and in 60\% of hard ones. Code is available at: https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory.
title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
title_translated: 移动AI工厂：为您的移动设备构建专用语言模型
summary_translated: 运行在移动设备上的小型语言模型（SLMs）能够保持用户数据隐私并离线工作。但它们只有在针对目标任务进行微调且适配目标设备尺寸时才能表现良好，而这一过程目前需要反复的专家调优。我们提出{	extit{Mobile AI Factory}}，一个智能体系统，可为给定任务和手机自动构建微调后的量化SLM。给定任务说明和目标手机后，一个协调器LLM决定是否调整超参数、挖掘真实数据或生成合成示例，同时固定规则会回滚损害准确性的更改。该工厂从基础模型和量化方案中从小到大搜索模型，根据搜索进展动态调整准确率目标，并利用目标手机在不同推理引擎和后端的真实测量数据。我们在十个任务和四部Android手机上评估了Mobile AI Factory。在未见过的测试集上，其本地模型在五个任务上优于两个五次提示的前沿模型，最高提升达0.34，并在另外三个任务上达到相当水平。其搜索在实体抽取任务上与穷举训练全部27种模型变体的性能相差仅0.03，但GPU时间节省了19倍。手机测量数据也至关重要：最佳配置因手机而异。若无手机测量数据，仅凭完整硬件和模型规格，Claude Opus 5.5在25%的简单和中等案例及60%的困难案例中未能满足应用需求。代码已公开于：https://github.com/evanly-gh/SLM_Factory。

summary: Most language models deployed outside the United States and China are fine-tuned descendants of a small number of pretrained families. We argue that fine-tuning leaves the decisive properties of a model inherited from its base: vocabulary, knowledge, cultural alignment, memorized data and license. We contribute (i) an updated, reproducible measurement of the tokenization premium across 31 languages and 7 tokenizers released in 2023-2024, on 27 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with explicit correction for unknown-token collapse. Premiums reach 10x for Amharic in older tokenizers and remain at 6.8x in the newest commercial one; Indigenous South American languages pay between 1.6x and 2.7x under global tokenizers. A vocabulary built from Portuguese lowers the premium for 11 of 13 Latin-script Global South languages relative to every global tokenizer tested, by about 24% for Guarani and Quechua. (ii) An eight-test black-box sovereignty audit that a buyer can run without access to weights. (iii) A regime argument: under energy and liability constraints, accuracy per joule, calibration and selective risk should replace raw accuracy as design objectives, with metrics that abstention cannot inflate. We close with preliminary internal measurements from a proprietary architecture built around these objectives, reported with their limitations. Data and measurement code are included.
title: Inherited Weights: Measuring the Tokenization Premium and the Sovereignty Cost of Language Models for the Global South

title_translated: 继承权重：衡量语言模型在“全球南方”的分词溢价与主权成本
summary_translated: 大多数在美国和中国以外部署的语言模型都是少数几个预训练家族的微调衍生品。我们认为，微调保留了模型的关键属性——词汇表、知识、文化契合度、记忆数据和许可证。我们贡献了：(i) 对2023–2024年发布的7个分词器在31种语言上的分词溢价更新、可复现的测量，基于《世界人权宣言》的27篇文章，并显式校正未知词符坍塌问题；旧分词器中阿姆哈拉语的溢价高达10倍，即使在最新的商业分词器中仍维持在6.8倍；美洲原住民语言在全局分词器下溢价介于1.6倍至2.7倍之间。基于葡萄牙语构建的词汇表使13种拉丁字母的全球南方语言中11种的溢价相对于所有测试的全局分词器降低了约24%（如瓜拉尼语和克丘亚语）。(ii) 一种无需访问权重即可由买家运行的八项黑盒主权审计方法。(iii) 一种制度论点：在能源和责任约束下，应以每焦耳精度、校准度和选择性风险取代原始准确率作为设计目标，且这些指标不能通过回避来虚增。最后，我们报告了一个围绕这些目标构建的专有架构的初步内部测量结果，附带其局限性。数据和测量代码均已包含。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.
title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
title_translated: BioMem：面向生物医学LLM智能体的代理记忆系统
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学应用中展现出巨大潜力，而代理记忆系统作为一种有前景的方法，可用于跨任务和交互中保存和利用信息。然而，一个根本性问题仍未解决：这些系统在保留、检索、更新和利用生物医学信息方面的有效性和可靠性如何？本研究系统地探究了生物医学领域的代理记忆，重点关注任务有效性、检索质量、信息保真度和长期鲁棒性。我们在三种代表性场景（生物医学知识推理、临床预测、长期对话记忆）中，评估了四种LLM上的五种记忆方法。分析揭示了记忆构建、证据相关性与对话历史如何塑造下游生物医学表现，突出了在检索相关信息、保持其保真度以及有效用于推理方面所面临的独特挑战。基于这些发现，我们提出了无需训练的混合记忆检索与利用框架（HMRU），该框架联合提升证据可访问性与任务感知利用能力，从而改善生物医学推理和长期对话记忆。HMRU在生物医学问答和对话记忆基准测试中平均相对提升8.6%，并在部分临床预测任务中取得额外增益。它进一步将对话回答错误减少24.9%，并弥补了48.0%的全上下文推理性能差距。我们的研究为生物医学代理记忆提供了系统性表征，并为开发更有效、更可靠的增强记忆LLM系统提供了实用洞见。

summary: In teaching and learning environments, cheating and the violation of academic integrity have always been one of the challenges, involving different levels of concerns such as administrative, personal knowledge, learning, and equity. The introduction of large language models has brought cheating in dialogue to the forefront, given the apparent capabilities of these models to complete students' academic assignments. This study aims to leverage recent dialogues among university professors about cheating with Generative AI to better understand their beliefs about academic honesty. In doing so, we analyze a corpus of 2.01 million posts (threads and comments) in the r/Professors subreddit discussing cheating after the release of ChatGPT, providing a better understanding of teachers' motivations to discourage cheating and the strategies they use to do so. We synthesize the why and how of addressing cheating to identify caveats about the future of AI and academic integration.
title: Mapping Instructors' Attitudes Towards Cheating with AI: An Exploratory Analysis Using Forum Analysis

title_translated: 映射教师对AI作弊态度的探索性分析：基于论坛内容的研究
summary_translated: 在教学与学习环境中，作弊及学术诚信的破坏始终是一个挑战，涉及管理、个人知识、学习和公平等多个层面的关注。大型语言模型的引入使对话中的作弊问题凸显，因为这些模型显然具备完成学生学术作业的能力。本研究旨在利用大学教授关于生成式AI作弊的最新对话，更好地理解他们对学术诚信的看法。为此，我们分析了r/Professors子版块中201万条帖子（主题和评论）的语料库，讨论ChatGPT发布后的作弊现象，从而更深入地了解教师制止作弊的动机及其所采用的策略。我们综合归纳了应对作弊的动因与方法，以识别未来AI与学术融合中可能存在的隐患。

summary: The extensive adoption of AI has precipitated a crisis in academic integrity. While studies attempt to quantify cheating, less is known about the motivations instructors believe students have for using AI in prohibited ways. We analyze 2.01 million posts on r/Professors to understand how instructors perceive students' justifications for AI-mediated cheating. Our qualitative analyses reveal four primary themes: (1) Academic System Gaming, (2) Digital-Academic Literacy Gap, (3) Performance Anxiety, and (4) Normalization of Dishonesty.
title: Understanding Students' Rationales for AI-Mediated Cheating: An Instructor Perspective from Online Forums Analysis

title_translated: 从教师视角理解学生使用AI作弊的理由：基于在线论坛的分析
summary_translated: AI的广泛采用引发了学术诚信危机。尽管已有研究尝试量化作弊行为，但关于教师认为学生为何以禁止方式使用AI的动机仍知之甚少。我们分析了r/Professors上201万条帖子，以理解教师如何看待学生使用AI作弊的正当化理由。定性分析揭示了四个主要主题：(1) 学术系统博弈，(2) 数字-学术素养差距，(3) 成绩焦虑，(4) 不诚实行为的正常化。

summary: In social science research, text annotation is a fundamental task that is traditionally a costly, hard-to-scale manual process. Researchers have used large language models (LLMs) to perform annotation by writing a definition of a concept into a prompt - a rule that determines whether a label should be attributed to a text depending on its content. However, concepts such as hate speech, fake news, and terrorism typically have several theoretically defensible competing definitions. It is also unknown whether the model actually applied the definition to provide the label or the label was based on the model's pretrained notion of the concept. To test this, we have the model annotate the same texts twice, each time with a different definition. We call the disagreement between the two sets of annotations definition sensitivity. As a control, we paraphrase one definition but leave its requirements unchanged - the disagreement between the annotations with the two wordings becomes the paraphrase floor. Across six concepts and three LLMs, a swap of competing definitions always changes more annotations, on average, than a paraphrase. This shows that the annotations depend on the prompted definition, so any set of annotations should be interpreted together with the definition that produced it. The LLM annotator's definition sensitivity and its paraphrase floor should both be reported in such work.
title: Measuring Definition Sensitivity in LLM Annotation of Social Science Concepts

title_translated: 测量大语言模型在社会科学概念标注中的定义敏感性
summary_translated: 在社会科学研究中，文本标注是一项基础任务，传统上是耗时且难以扩展的手工过程。研究人员已使用大语言模型（LLMs）通过在提示中编写概念定义来执行标注——该规则决定根据文本内容是否应赋予某一标签。然而，诸如仇恨言论、假新闻和恐怖主义等概念通常存在多个理论上可辩护的竞争性定义。目前尚不清楚模型是真正依据所提示的定义进行标注，还是基于其预训练中对该概念的固有理解。为检验这一点，我们让模型对同一组文本两次标注，每次使用不同的定义。我们将两组标注之间的不一致称为“定义敏感性”。作为对照，我们对一个定义进行改写但保持其要求不变——两组不同表述下的标注差异即为“改写基线”。在六个概念和三个LLM的实验中，更换竞争性定义导致的标注变化量平均高于改写基线。这表明标注结果依赖于提示中的定义，因此任何标注结果都必须与其生成所用的定义一同解释。在相关工作中，应同时报告LLM标注者的定义敏感性和改写基线。

summary: Recent work has identified a set of emergent symbolic mechanisms that support abstract reasoning in large language models, but it remains unclear what factors drive the emergence of these mechanisms. To address this question, we trained neural networks from scratch on abstract sequence tasks, varying both architectural and data distributional factors, and investigated the effects of these factors on the emergence of symbolic mechanisms. Using representational, attentional, and causal mediation analyses, we first confirmed that transformer-based language models trained from scratch on our task developed symbolic mechanisms. We then found that, across multiple axes of data diversity, greater diversity produced stronger symbolic signatures. Surprisingly, the same signatures emerged in modified transformer architectures and even multilayer perceptrons, indicating that architectural inductive biases are not necessary for the development of symbolic mechanisms. We also observed consistent patterns in an entity-attribute binding task. Together, these findings identify data diversity, not architecture, as the primary driver of emergent symbolic computation in neural networks.
title: What drives the emergence of symbolic mechanisms in large language models?

title_translated: 是什么驱动了大语言模型中符号机制的出现？
summary_translated: 近期研究识别出一组支持大语言模型抽象推理的涌现符号机制，但这些机制的出现究竟由哪些因素驱动仍不明确。为回答这一问题，我们在抽象序列任务上从零开始训练神经网络，同时改变架构和数据分布等因素，并研究这些因素对符号机制出现的影响。通过表示、注意力和因果中介分析，我们首先确认了在我们的任务上从零训练的基于Transformer的语言模型发展出了符号机制。随后发现，在多个数据多样性维度上，更高的多样性会产生更强的符号特征。令人惊讶的是，即使在修改后的Transformer架构甚至多层感知机中也观察到了相同的符号特征，表明架构的归纳偏置并非符号机制发展的必要条件。我们在实体-属性绑定任务中也发现了类似的一致模式。综上，这些发现表明，数据多样性而非架构，是神经网络中涌现符号计算的主要驱动力。

summary: Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays constant across deployments, and a retrained or re-released model is a new model that a two-cell screen, one retention run and one deletion run, re-reads for the cost of two runs. Deletion sensitivity is thus a measurable property of the model, and the reading must enter routing and aggregation as prior information rather than persist as an invisible default cost.
title: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models

title_translated: 删除敏感性是模型的属性：在七种开源推理模型上的三条件测量
summary_translated: 推理模型在多轮工具调用会话中每一步都会生成推理轨迹，后续步骤会读取该历史记录。在9.4万次ShareGPT对话中，73%的用户交互跨越多个回合。上游服务将每个轨迹与其发起者绑定，因此跨发起者转发请求时，其历史会被删除，而这种删除带来的任务成本尚未被测量。据我们所知，本文首次通过三种渲染条件、七种开源权重推理模型、三个种子、794个任务和官方校验器，对多轮工具调用中的完整推理历史删除进行了直接、盲测、多种子测量。相同的删除操作导致得分变化范围为-4.4至+51.3分，两端均不包含零；对于一个从0%到100%重新设定删除率的模型，其读取结果最多仅变化1.5分。删除敏感性是模型级别的属性：读取结果随模型本身而定，在部署间保持稳定；重新训练或重新发布的模型被视为新模型，只需一次保留运行和一次删除运行即可重新评估，成本仅为两次运行。因此，删除敏感性是可测量的模型属性，其读取结果必须作为先验信息纳入路由和聚合决策，而非作为不可见的默认成本持续存在。

summary: Cultural adaptation in dialogue systems refers to the ability to generate responses that conform to linguistic norms and social expectations across different cultures. However, existing dialogue generation approaches pay limited attention to the role of personality in shaping cultural expression and communication style. We therefore propose HiCAP, a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation. HiCAP employs a personality-conditioned control mechanism that hierarchically modulates response style by first aligning it with the cultural tone and then refining linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes. To embed these factors, the model combines supervised fine-tuning and instruction-based tuning, supported by dynamic instruction templates and multi-agent demonstrations to capture diverse combinations of culture and personality. Experiments on CulturalPersonas and CPED show that HiCAP achieves the strongest overall performance across various dialogue generation metrics, demonstrating effective cultural adaptability and personality modelling.
title: HiCAP: Hierarchical Cultural Adaptation via Personality for Dialogue Generation
title_translated: HiCAP：基于个性的层次化文化适应对话生成
summary_translated: 对话系统中的文化适应指的是生成符合不同文化语言规范和社会期望回应的能力。然而，现有的对话生成方法对个性在塑造文化表达和沟通风格方面的作用关注有限。为此，我们提出了HiCAP，一种将个性特征融入文化自适应对话生成的新框架。HiCAP采用个性条件控制机制，通过首先与文化基调对齐，再根据个体个性属性细化语言表达和内容，分层调节回应风格。为嵌入这些因素，模型结合了监督微调和基于指令的调优，借助动态指令模板和多智能体演示来捕捉文化与个性的多样化组合。在CulturalPersonas和CPED数据集上的实验表明，HiCAP在多种对话生成指标上均取得最强整体性能，展现出有效的文化适应性和个性建模能力。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted with mathematical, scientific and engineering work, yet their mistakes are often confidently written and hard to spot. A single wrong step tends to propagate, making the model waste inference tokens following a false premise. Existing safeguards either check only the final answer and restart from scratch, or rely on a verifier LLM that competes for GPU capacity and slows down response time. We propose online, deterministic verification: many kinds of reasoning steps can be validated by code, so a step can be verified in real time, as it is written, without any model call or GPU use. Whenever a check fails, we point out the mistake and let the model continue from the same spot. We demonstrate this approach on symbolic mathematics, where derivations already contain explicit expressions that a computer algebra system can check in milliseconds. Tested on the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, our online validation improves accuracy by 1.4-5.6 percentage points, corresponding to a 1.8-14.9% net reduction in incorrect answers, while increasing token usage by only 6-7%. Because the verifier is independent of the model, the approach complements progress in LLMs rather than competing with it: every new model can benefit immediately, and the benefit grows as deterministic checkers extend to more kinds of reasoning steps.
title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
title_translated: 在错误发生时即时捕捉：大语言模型推理过程中的实时纠错
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于数学、科学和工程任务，但其错误往往以自信的方式呈现且难以发现。一个错误步骤往往会持续传播，导致模型在错误前提下浪费推理令牌。现有防护机制要么仅检查最终答案并从头重启，要么依赖Verifier LLM，这会争夺GPU资源并降低响应速度。我们提出在线、确定性验证：许多推理步骤可通过代码验证，因此可在生成过程中实时验证，无需任何模型调用或GPU使用。一旦检查失败，我们指出错误并让模型从同一位置继续。我们在符号数学任务上验证该方法，其中推导已包含计算机代数系统可在毫秒内检查的显式表达式。在ASyMoB基准测试中，使用三个开源权重模型，我们的在线验证使准确率提升1.4至5.6个百分点，对应错误答案净减少1.8%至14.9%，同时仅增加6%-7%的令牌使用量。由于验证器独立于模型，该方法可与LLM进展互补而非竞争：每个新模型均可立即受益，且随着确定性检查器扩展到更多推理类型，收益将持续增长。

summary: Languages of India need 1.6 to 14 times as many tokens as English on GPT-4o's tokenizer for the same content, which makes them more expensive and slower to serve. We train tokenizers from scratch on human-written text in about 200 languages. Havon v3 is a byte-level BPE tokenizer with 262,144 tokens and a pre-tokenizer that keeps combining marks with their letters and chunks scripts written without spaces. On FLORES-200 devtest it needs fewer tokens than GPT-4o's o200k_base on all 25 languages of India (median 0.74 of GPT-4o's count) and on 172 of 204 languages, but 7% more on English. Havon v4 adds a second, multi-word training stage (SuperBPE) to v3. At exactly GPT-4o's vocabulary size of 200,019 tokens, v4 needs 6.1% fewer tokens than GPT-4o on English and fewer on 161 of 204 languages and all 25 languages of India (median 0.74); at the same size, v3 needs 9.4% more on English and wins on 133. With 262,144 tokens, v4 needs 9.6% fewer tokens on English and fewer on 182 of 204 languages, and with 524,288 tokens it needs fewer on 203 of 204. The gains are largest for English, Hindi and the Romance languages; scripts without spaces, such as Khmer, Burmese and Tibetan, gain little and lose subword merges. Havon v5 replaces v4's Python-only code sample with permissively licensed code in 15 languages: on code it needs 1.03 to 1.22 times GPT-4o's tokens, against 1.11 to 1.29 for v4, while keeping all 25 languages of India (median 0.74, all significant under a sentence-level bootstrap) and English (0.94). These are compression results only: we have not yet evaluated a model trained with v4 or v5.
title: A Multi-Word Tokenizer for 204 Languages That Needs Fewer Tokens Than GPT-4o's, Including on English
title_translated: 支持204种语言的多词分词器，比GPT-4o更少令牌，包括英语
summary_translated: 印度语言在GPT-4o分词器下的令牌数量是英语的1.6至14倍，导致其服务成本更高、速度更慢。我们从头训练了约200种语言的人类撰写文本的分词器。Havon v3是一种字节级BPE分词器，拥有262,144个词汇，预分词器将组合标记与其字母保持在一起，并将无空格书写的脚本分块处理。在FLORES-200开发测试集上，v3在所有25种印度语言（中位数为GPT-4o的0.74倍）和204种语言中的172种上所需令牌少于GPT-4o，但在英语上多出7%。Havon v4在v3基础上增加了第二阶段多词训练（SuperBPE）。在与GPT-4o相同的200,019个词汇量下，v4在英语上比GPT-4o少6.1%的令牌，且在161种语言和全部25种印度语言上表现更优（中位数0.74）；相同规模下，v3在英语上多出9.4%，但在133种语言上胜出。在262,144个词汇量下，v4在英语上少9.6%的令牌，且在182种语言上更优；在524,288个词汇量下，除一种语言外其余均更优。收益最大的是英语、印地语和罗曼语族语言；无空格脚本（如高棉文、缅甸文、藏文）增益较小且损失子词合并。Havon v5将v4的仅Python代码样本替换为15种语言的宽松许可代码：在代码上所需令牌为GPT-4o的1.03至1.22倍，而v4为1.11至1.29倍，同时保持全部25种印度语言（中位数0.74，句级Bootstrap检验显著）和英语（0.94）的表现。以上仅为压缩结果，尚未评估使用v4或v5训练的模型。

summary: Commercial language model APIs bill per token, so a tokenizer that needs more tokens for the same content in one language makes that language more expensive, slower, and able to fit less text in a fixed context window. We measure this disparity for nine public tokenizers, including those of GPT-4, GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-V3, Mistral-Nemo and four Sarvam models, on all 25 languages of India available in FLORES-200 (2,009 professionally translated sentences aligned with English) and on 13,732 human-translated Hinglish-English social media pairs from PHINC. On GPT-4o's tokenizer the same content needs between 1.57 times (Hindi) and 5.01 times (Odia) the tokens of English, and 13.7 times for Santali in Ol Chiki script; GPT-4's tokenizer needs up to 12.8 times. Sarvam-30B/105B is the only third-party tokenizer that stays below 2.6 times on every language (median 1.53). In an illustrative scenario using official list prices accessed on 5 November 2026 and stated assumptions, a support bot handling 100,000 chats a month on GPT-4o would cost about INR 56,640 in English and INR 102,829 in Marathi; these are estimates, not measured production costs. Against an openly licensed Hindi and Marathi morphological segmentation set, no tokenizer places more than 35% of its word-internal boundaries on morpheme boundaries (boundary F1 at most 0.48). In a companion paper we present a tokenizer that reduces this tax. Code, pinned artifacts and raw token counts are available at https://github.com/HavonAI/indic-token-tax.
title: The Indic Token Tax in 2026: Measuring Tokenizer. Disparity and Its Cost for the Languages of India

summary: Thai is written without spaces between words, making segmentation a foundational step in most Thai NLP pipelines. Existing tools primarily reproduce the word-level conventions of corpora such as BEST; however, because the notion of a "word" in Thai lacks a unified linguistic consensus, these conventions struggle with productive compounding, leading to arbitrary boundaries and ambiguity in downstream representations. Instead, we propose operating at the morphological level, focusing on khammoon, the smallest atomic unit that carries meaning. Segmenting at the morphemic level provides an explicit, consistent morphological representation that eliminates compounding ambiguity. Crucially, this representation benefits downstream learning: models trained on morphemes perform on par with or exceed word-level baselines across part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, and sentiment classification, demonstrating that linguistic consistency improves representation quality without downstream performance penalty. To operationalize this representation, we translate linguistic principles into a formal decision guideline with near-perfect human agreement ($κ\approx 0.99$), scale annotation with an LLM, and correct systematic errors with human labels. Finally, we train khammoon, a lightweight 1M-parameter convolutional BiLSTM segmenter designed for efficient CPU inference, achieving a boundary F1 of 0.992 on out-of-domain text. The guideline, datasets, model, and library are all publicly released.
title: khammoon: From a Linguistic Guideline to a Thai Morpheme Segmenter

summary: Knowledge editing has emerged as a promising approach for efficiently updating embedded knowledge in large language models (LLMs). It first computes an ideal target hidden state that steers the LLM toward the new output, and then edits the model parameters so that the original hidden state is mapped to this target. While most existing methods focus on the second stage of parameter editing in preserving other knowledge, we find that the upstream construction of the target hidden state also plays an important role in allocating the model's limited capacity space. We first establish a theoretical connection between interference in the parameter space and interference between target hidden states, showing that the two are positively correlated. Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective $\ell_1$ regularization method that prunes away unnecessary ``tentacles'' of each knowledge vector, retaining only the essential components. With fewer extraneous tentacles, each edit affects less other knowledge, enabling better coexistence. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of our method. Code: https://github.com/wintersdragon-c/STO.
title: Capacity Allocation at the Source: Sparse Target Optimization for LLM Knowledge Editing

title_translated: 源端容量分配：面向大语言模型知识编辑的稀疏目标优化

summary: Offline web-behavior benchmarks frequently insert the demonstrated action into a finite candidate set and then measure reranking. We show that this protocol can create a candidate-support confound: when the target is outside training support while all distractors are sampled from that support, support membership identifies the gold action without modeling behavior. We formalize this effect with support-identifiability rate (SIR), construct support-balanced candidate sets, and evaluate a target-free dual-path proposer that combines support retrieval with open-vocabulary DOM/LM proposals. On filtered OPeRA (4,282/469/992 train/dev/test steps), the original protocol has SIR 1.0000 on target-OOV rows and a support-only rule reaches 1.0000 OOV Exact@1. Support balancing reduces SIR to 0.0000; the strongest conditional reranker obtains 0.7214 overall Exact@1, 0.7988 on IV rows, and 0.5668 on OOV rows. The target-free dual-path system reaches Proposal Recall@16 0.6915 and end-to-end Exact@1 0.5212, compared with oracle conditional Exact@1 0.7450. On Mind2Web, the same audit yields SIR 0.2380 and an oracle-to-proposal gap of 0.2125. A 200-row semantic audit labels 0.7150 of exact-key OOV targets as semantically novel, 0.2450 as locator/string variation, and 0.0400 as ambiguous (Cohen's $κ=0.8173$). These measurements show why support composition must be controlled alongside candidate accuracy when offline results are used to reason about deployment.
title: IntentTwin: Deconfounding Candidate Support and the Oracle-to-Deployment Gap in Offline Web Behavior Prediction

summary: This work presents a new benchmark that aims to address the limitations of current methods for evaluating LLMs in Brazilian Portuguese. We introduced Brasilidade, an assessment methodology comprised of standardized tasks distributed across four different domains, and we are making available the tasks from its first domain, which address nuances of the language, grammar, and variations of Brazilian Portuguese. The results show that model size, by itself, does not determine performance; several medium-sized models outperformed larger models in the protocols evaluated. Specific models for Portuguese, in general, did not perform above average, despite their targeted training. Different task levels revealed significant nuances: while some tasks proved easy for most models, others posed extreme challenges, and some yielded mixed results, with wide variations in performance. This clearly illustrates the need for benchmarks that address the limitations of the models in Brazilian Portuguese, allowing future training cycles to seek to overcome them. Project repository https://github.com/soberania-oficial/brasilidade
title: Brasilidade: Measuring Brazilian Identity for Large Language Models

summary_translated: 本文提出了一项新的基准，旨在解决当前评估大语言模型在巴西葡萄牙语中表现的方法局限性。我们引入了Brasilidade，一种由四个不同领域标准化任务组成的评估方法，并公开了其第一领域的任务，涵盖巴西葡萄牙语的语言细微差别、语法及变体。结果显示，模型规模本身并不能决定性能；多个中等规模模型在所评估协议中表现优于更大模型。尽管经过针对性训练，通用葡萄牙语模型整体表现并未优于平均水平。不同任务层级揭示了显著差异：部分任务对大多数模型而言较易，另一些则极具挑战性，还有一些结果混杂，性能波动极大。这清楚地说明了需要针对巴西葡萄牙语模型局限性的基准，以便未来训练周期能够有针对性地克服这些问题。项目仓库：https://github.com/soberania-oficial/brasilidade

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in clinical documentation workflows, where clinicians review and edit their outputs before use. In principle, these clinician edits represent a scalable source of supervision for model training. In practice, not all edits represent actionable feedback: for instance, on data drawn from real-world deployment of an AI clinical documentation product, our review suggests that over 45% of edited outputs contain user-added information that is not directly supported by the inputs to the model. Naively fine-tuning on such edits risks teaching the model to hallucinate. In this paper, we develop a method to address this challenge. Given that real clinician edits on deployed documentation tools are not publicly available, we first develop a taxonomy of clinician-editing behaviors, informed by data from a deployed AI clinical documentation product. Then, we develop a method for generating semi-synthetic clinician-edit data, informed by our taxonomy, on a discharge-summary generation task based on MIMIC-III, a public dataset. Finally, we introduce simple filtering methods for identifying actionable edits, with accuracy evaluated by expert review. We show empirically, on our semi-synthetic dataset, that naive fine-tuning on raw edited output increases ungrounded content, while our approach of progressively filtering toward grounded edits enables improvement on clinician-alignment metrics while retaining faithfulness to the input context.
title: Actionable Feedback: Improving Model Capabilities from User Edit Data on Clinical Documentation

title_translated: 可操作反馈：从临床文档用户编辑数据中提升模型能力
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于临床文档工作流中，医生在使用前会审查并编辑其输出。理论上，这些医生的编辑构成了可扩展的监督信号来源。但实际上，并非所有编辑都代表可操作反馈：例如，在真实部署的AI临床文档产品数据中，我们的分析表明超过45%的编辑输出包含用户添加但未直接由模型输入支持的信息。若对这类编辑进行盲目微调，可能导致模型产生幻觉。本文我们提出一种应对该挑战的方法。由于真实部署工具中的医生编辑数据不可公开获取，我们首先基于已部署AI临床文档产品的数据，构建了一个医生编辑行为分类体系。随后，我们基于该分类体系，在MIMIC-III公开数据集上的出院摘要生成任务中，开发了一种生成半合成医生编辑数据的方法。最后，我们引入简单的过滤方法以识别可操作编辑，并通过专家评审评估其准确性。我们在半合成数据集上实证表明，对原始编辑输出进行朴素微调会增加无根据内容，而我们逐步过滤至有依据编辑的方法，则能在保持输入上下文忠实性的同时，提升与医生对齐的指标表现。

summary: Context compression is now routine for language models with long inputs, but a compressed context is useful only if it keeps the evidence for the answer. Existing checks compare the reader model's answer or its most likely words, and thus miss a frequent failure, silent evidence loss: key evidence is removed while the answer stays the same, leaving the answer unsupported and risky for other models that reuse the context. To address this challenge, we propose SELD (Silent Evidence Loss Detector), which needs no training and no labels. Its principle is that when evidence is lost, a reader model's preferences among the answers it leaves unsaid shift even if its answer does not, so comparing these preferences before and after compression reveals losses that answer checks cannot see. We also build SEL-Pairs, a benchmark of length-matched evidence and control deletions from three question-answering datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments with five reader models on it show that SELD consistently outperforms strong and recent baselines across compressors, compression rates and models, identifying the evidence-removing edit in 83% of matched pairs with unchanged answers, against 70% for the strongest baseline. These results show that evidence loss in compressed contexts can be detected even when the answer is unchanged.
title: SELD: Detecting Silent Evidence Loss in Context Compression beyond the Answer
title_translated: SELD：检测上下文压缩中超出答案之外的沉默证据损失
summary_translated: 长输入的语言模型如今普遍采用上下文压缩技术，但压缩后的上下文只有在保留答案所需证据时才有效。现有检测方法仅比较阅读模型的答案或其最可能的词语，因此常遗漏一种常见失败——沉默证据损失：关键证据被删除，但答案保持不变，导致答案失去支持，对后续复用该上下文的模型构成风险。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SELD（沉默证据损失检测器），其无需训练也无需标签。其原理是：当证据丢失时，即使答案不变，阅读模型对其未说出答案的偏好也会发生变化，通过比较压缩前后这些偏好的变化，可发现答案检查无法察觉的损失。我们还构建了SELPairs，一个来自三个问答数据集的长度匹配证据删除与控制删除的基准。在五个阅读模型上的定量与定性实验表明，SELD在各类压缩器、压缩率和模型上均持续优于强基线与近期方法，在答案不变的匹配对中成功识别出83%的证据删除操作，优于最强基线的70%。这些结果表明，即使答案未改变，压缩上下文中的证据损失也可被检测到。

summary: Time series from real-world systems are often accompanied by text, such as a report on an event that affects them. Two common tasks on these series are understanding, e.g., answering questions about a series, and forecasting its future values. Both tasks require reasoning over the series and the text together. Moreover, understanding outputs text while forecasting outputs a time series, so serving both requires a model that reads and generates both modalities. Large language models (LLMs) read time series as digit tokens and handle long series poorly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast well from large-scale pretraining but typically neither read nor generate text. Time series language models add a time series modality to the LLM but forecast on the LLM side, leaving the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability unused. We present TimeOmni-o1, which couples a pretrained TSFM and an LLM bidirectionally. In one direction, the TSFM encodes the series in compressed form for the LLM, which reasons over it together with the text. In the other, the LLM's reasoning is fed back into the TSFM, which produces the forecast conditioned on it. One model architecture thus reads and generates both series and text, reasons in text, and draws on the TSFM's pretrained forecasting ability. To train it, we build MMTR, a multimodal time series reasoning dataset with annotated reasoning traces, covering both tasks across 12 domains with 500k+ samples. On MMTR, TimeOmni-o1 outperforms existing models on both understanding and forecasting across most domains, as well as the LLM and the TSFM inside it when used individually. The gains carry over to three open benchmarks, where it outperforms the dedicated time series models.
title: TimeOmni-o1: Bidirectionally Coupling Time Series Foundation Models and LLMs for Multimodal Reasoning and Forecasting

title_translated: TimeOmni-o1：通过时间序列基础模型与大语言模型的双向耦合实现多模态推理与预测
summary_translated: 现实世界系统的时间序列数据通常伴随文本信息，例如影响这些序列的事件报告。针对此类序列的两个常见任务是理解（如回答关于序列的问题）和预测未来值。这两个任务都需要对序列和文本进行联合推理。此外，理解任务输出文本，而预测任务输出时间序列，因此同时支持两者需要一个能够读取和生成两种模态的模型。大语言模型（LLMs）将时间序列作为数字标记读取，对长序列处理能力较差；时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在大规模预训练后具有良好的预测能力，但通常既不读取也不生成文本；时间序列语言模型虽在LLM中增加了时间序列模态，但预测仍由LLM完成，导致TSFM的预训练预测能力被浪费。我们提出TimeOmni-o1，通过双向耦合预训练的TSFM与LLM。一方面，TSFM将序列以压缩形式编码供LLM使用，LLM结合文本进行推理；另一方面，LLM的推理结果反馈给TSFM，使其基于该推理生成条件预测。这一统一架构可读取并生成序列与文本，进行文本推理，并利用TSFM的预训练预测能力。为训练该模型，我们构建了MMTR——一个包含标注推理轨迹的多模态时间序列推理数据集，覆盖12个领域，样本超过50万条。在MMTR上，TimeOmni-o1在大多数领域均优于现有模型，在理解与预测任务上表现均超越其内部的LLM与TSFM单独使用时的表现。该优势也延伸至三个开放基准测试，其性能超过专用时间序列模型。

summary: Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. We argue that anomalous steps can be identified by measuring the entropy deviation of each denoising step from its neighboring temporal window. We hypothesize that discrete token commitment discards the distributional information at masked positions, limiting the continued interaction between candidate semantics and the context during entropy spikes. With this goal, we present StepRefine, a plug-and-play decoding strategy that leverages semantic context to achieve reliable denoising. The core of our method lies in a step-aware switch between discrete denoising and latent refinement. The model employs probability-weighted embeddings at entropy spike steps to preserve diverse reasoning hypotheses and performs multiple rounds of continuous refinement. Meanwhile, a refinement controller monitors distributional stability to reduce unnecessary loops and switch the model back to standard discrete denoising. Through extensive experiments, StepRefine demonstrates significant hallucination mitigation across different MDLMs on multimodal benchmarks.
title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
title_translated: 脉冲重思：通过步骤感知解码缓解多模态扩散语言模型中的幻觉
summary_translated: 近期多模态扩散语言模型（MDLMs）通过迭代精炼展现出强大的全局建模能力。我们观察到，在迭代去噪过程中，掩码不确定性整体呈下降趋势，但少数去噪步骤出现局部熵峰，与幻觉密切相关。我们认为，可通过测量每个去噪步骤与其邻近时间窗口的熵偏差来识别异常步骤。我们假设，离散标记承诺会丢弃掩码位置的分布信息，限制候选语义与上下文在熵峰期间的持续交互。为此，我们提出StepRefine，一种即插即用的解码策略，利用语义上下文实现可靠去噪。其核心在于在离散去噪与潜在空间精炼之间进行步骤感知切换。在熵峰步骤，模型采用概率加权嵌入以保留多样化的推理假设，并执行多轮连续精炼。同时，精炼控制器监控分布稳定性，减少不必要的循环，并在必要时切换回标准离散去噪。大量实验表明，StepRefine在不同MDLMs的多模态基准测试中显著缓解了幻觉问题。

summary: Longitudinal social-media histories offer an opportunity to assess depression, potentially supporting the inference of standardized depression questionnaire responses. However, this task requires evidence that is semantically relevant to a symptom and attributable to the user, while being sufficiently specific to support an individual questionnaire item. Existing approaches rely on semantic similarity to retrieve posts, which can introduce misleading or non-attributable evidence, particularly in multi-symptom posts and discussions of others' experiences. We propose SREE (Symptom Retrieval and Evidence-Grounded InfErence), an evidence-grounded pipeline that extracts first-person and symptom-specific text spans, selects a representative subset using a Facility Location-inspired objective, and performs Evidence-Gated Inference over the selected evidence. We evaluate evidence retrieval on BDI-Sen and evidence-conditioned questionnaire inference on eRisk 2019-2021. Compared with state-of-the-art retrieval approaches, SREE achieves relative improvements of 70% in post-level precision and 59% in F1, while retaining at least 30% fewer posts. On multi-symptom sentences, it also outperforms dense retrieval in precision and F1 even with twice the retrieval budget. Across all three eRisk collections, SREE achieves the highest exact item-level agreement while remaining competitive on ordinal and aggregate metrics. These results highlight the importance of localizing attributable evidence and controlling its composition before inferring depression questionnaire responses.
title: From Relevant Posts to Attributable Spans: Explicit Symptom Evidence for Depression Questionnaire Inference
title_translated: 从相关帖子到可归因片段：抑郁症问卷推断中的显式症状证据
summary_translated: 纵向社交媒体记录为评估抑郁症提供了机会，可能有助于推断标准化抑郁症问卷的回答。然而，该任务要求证据在语义上与症状相关、可归因于用户，并且足够具体以支持个体问卷条目。现有方法依赖语义相似性检索帖子，可能导致误导性或不可归因的证据，尤其在多症状帖子或他人经历讨论中更为明显。我们提出SREE（症状检索与证据 grounded 推理），一个基于证据的管道，用于提取第一人称且症状特定的文本片段，使用受设施选址启发的目标选择代表性子集，并在选定证据上执行证据门控推理。我们在BDI-Sen上评估证据检索，在eRisk 2019-2021上评估证据条件下的问卷推断。相比最先进的检索方法，SREE在帖子级精确率上提升70%，F1提升59%，同时保留的帖子数量至少减少30%。在多症状句子中，即使检索预算翻倍，SREE在精确率和F1上仍优于密集检索。在所有三个eRisk数据集上，SREE在项目级精确匹配上达到最高水平，同时在序数和聚合指标上保持竞争力。这些结果凸显了在推断抑郁症问卷回答前，定位可归因证据并控制其组成的重要性。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.
title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
title_translated: AutoScaffold：面向语言模型强化学习的AI引导支架构建
summary_translated: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）产生丰富的训练经验，但结果奖励将每次尝试简化为单一数值，导致大部分信息未被利用。训练期间的支架（如提示中添加的策略或提示）可自然地将这些信息转化为指导，但其设计与适应通常依赖人工，且针对特定领域定制。我们引入AutoScaffold，一个统一的AI for AI框架，将学生的学习经验转化为自适应支架，仅需极少领域特定信息，且训练过程中无需人工干预。一个冻结的教师模型定期检查该经验，诊断瓶颈，并以两种形式设计支架：(i) 跨任务类共享的通用策略；(ii) 针对个别困难任务的提示，根据学生学习进度动态调整支持内容与强度。评估阶段移除支架。我们将同一框架应用于ALFWorld、基于搜索的问答、数学推理和GPU内核生成任务。在无支架评估下，使用AutoScaffold训练的学生在四个领域均优于对应RL基线，ALFWorld成功率达7.2分提升，平均QA精确匹配提升4.0分。在GPU内核生成任务中，AutoScaffold使正确且比PyTorch参考更快的内核占比提升最多达5.0分。在数学任务中，我们的学生仅用约三分之一的训练步数便超越QuestA报告的准确率。分析显示，教师在每类任务中识别出不同的失败模式，并随学生进步将支架从逐步工作流转向针对性修复；其修订后的支架帮助学生学习效果优于保留旧支架或完全无支架。

summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations

title_translated: 对比发现：基于竞争解释的开放式科学发现
summary_translated:
大语言模型代理越来越多地用于开放式、数据驱动的科学发现，但大多数代理采用逐点评估假设，仅将经验性主张 $h$ 与补集 $
eg h$ 进行比较。当证据拒绝 $h$ 时，代理仅得知某一解释可能性低，却无法确定证据支持哪个替代解释。为恢复该替代解释，我们引入对比发现（Contrastive Discovery），将单个假设替换为对比集合——一个科学问题及其互斥且穷尽的竞争解释。每次实验根据证据如何重新分配对集合中各解释的信任度进行评分，当信任集中于单一解释时，问题即被解决。由于对比集合仅改变代理提出和评分的单位，现有代理可将其用于重新评估已收集的证据，或引导其搜索过程。在六个领域中，89% 的逐点候选者中最大信念转移的是拒绝项。在相同证据下，对比集合能将其中73% 的候选者解析为具体替代解释。当对比集合引导搜索时，代理在相同实验预算下比逐点惊喜度方法多解决67% 的问题。在盲测研究中，38名人类专家在78% 的已解决问题上选择了相同解释，在82% 的逐点代理拒绝假设并停止的问题上也达成一致。这些结果共同支持：明确竞争解释是发现代理从相同证据和验证预算中解决更多科学问题的有效方式。

summary: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.
title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents

title_translated: 智能体评估框架的比较分析：企业级分析智能体中的稳定性、风险检测与未知风险发现
summary_translated: 在企业环境中部署基于大语言模型（LLM）的分析智能体，需要能够可靠检测复杂多工具工作流中故障的评估框架。我们对三种代表不同评估范式的评估框架进行了三阶段比较研究（基于轨迹的LLM判断、仅文本的LLM判断结合红队测试、确定性启发式方法），在受控研究环境中使用冻结执行轨迹应用于两个分析智能体。第一阶段通过重复测量量化评估框架的稳定性，发现97%的配置满足稳定性阈值，且稳定性模式与智能体无关。第二阶段在72个真实测试用例上衡量已知风险检测能力，基于轨迹的框架在精确率-召回率平衡上表现最佳（F1=0.90），而仅文本评估虽召回率相当但误报数量高出5倍。第三阶段评估未知风险发现能力，发现了24个全新缺陷，功能测试与安全红队测试之间无重叠。结果表明：（1）评估框架可用信息决定评估质量；（2）功能与安全评估具有互补性；（3）基于LLM的评估框架能揭示人类评审者遗漏的细微错误。我们建议采用双框架策略：基于轨迹的评估用于功能评估，对抗性红队测试用于安全验证。

summary: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.
title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking

title_translated: FERN：基于冻结检索器与学习排序的跨基准文本到SQL表检索
summary_translated: 在大型合并数据目录上构建文本到SQL系统时，首要任务是检索问题所需的表格。我们以RASL（使用Claude 3.5模型提取关键词并选择表格）在BIRD、Spider和Fiben合并数据集上的公开表召回率为基准进行对比。FERN（特征工程排序，无生成式LLM）将三个冻结检索器融合为100个候选表，每个候选表描述最多120个特征，并使用在BIRD训练问题上一次性拟合的LightGBM排序器重新排序。在Spider数据集上（未进行拟合），其候选池本身在15张表时达到RASL的公开召回率（98.0），排序器使前五名包含正确答案的问题比例（complete@5）从83.9%提升至95.6%。在5张表时，FERN在Spider上的召回率与RASL相差仅1分（96.7 vs 97.0），在BIRD带证据提示时也接近（96.6 vs 97.5），但在无提示时低8.2分（89.3）。在121个真实BEAVER问题上，未经过BEAVER微调的情况下，其15张表召回率为82.1，介于两个BEAVER训练过的检索器之间（80.8, 84.5），但complete@15低于两者（49.6 vs 54.5 和 62.0）。在Fiben上，15张表时差距较大（54.2 vs 69.2，问题集不同），尽管在50张表时召回率数值接近RASL仅使用问题检索的结果（80.7 vs 79.4）。在BIRD开发集上，非检索特征相比仅依赖检索信号可使complete@5提升7.7分。在BIRD开发集上，单个A100 GPU每问题平均延迟为208毫秒，无需调用托管模型。

summary: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic speech. On the same audiobooks, 69% of words are predicted correctly before they end, against 3-25% for the other models. For words still being spoken, confidence is calibrated, with an expected calibration error (ECE) of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets, it is more accurate than Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.
title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters

title_translated: Earlybird：2900万参数的预测性流式语音识别
summary_translated: 流式语音识别器通常在说话人完成发音后90至400毫秒才输出一个词。对于语音智能体而言，每一毫秒都至关重要：越早输出词语，智能体就能越早开始搜索或规划回复。我们提出Earlybird，一种2900万参数的流式识别器（4比特下为16.8 MB）。Earlybird通过在随机点截断的音频（包括部分单词中间）进行训练，并被要求预测到该时刻为止应出现的所有完整词语，以及接下来两个词语的猜测。其原始token概率为每个词语（包括仍在发音中的词语）提供了置信度。在干净的有声书语音（LibriSpeech test-clean）上，median单词比说话人结束提前90毫秒被正确预测，而现有流式模型则在结束后90至400毫秒才输出。Earlybird在我们测试的六个数据集上均表现最早，涵盖有声书、TED演讲、公共演讲、财报电话会议及合成语音。在同一有声书数据上，69%的词语在结束前就被正确预测，而其他模型仅为3%-25%。对于仍在发音的词语，置信度校准良好，预期校准误差（ECE）为3.7至5.5。在八个英语开放语音识别排行榜数据集上，其准确率优于Moonshine Tiny，与同规模的Whistle模型大致持平。

summary: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.
title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models

title_translated: 位数还是排列？在小型本地语言模型中固定推理预算下权重量精度与选项顺序平均的权衡
summary_translated: 本地语言模型可通过减少权重存储位数来节省内存，也可通过平均多个选项重排来降低对答案顺序的敏感性。我们探讨前者是否会削弱后者的效果，以及在固定预算下哪种方式更高效。在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B模型上，使用模拟四舍五入量化（8、6、4和3比特，fp16参考），从ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU和HellaSwag（各300项）的字母A-D logits读取结果。6比特权重相比fp16无精度损失（分别高出+1.8（+1.0至+2.5）和+0.9（+0.3至+1.5）分，原因未解释），8比特分别下降-0.7（-1.1至-0.3）和-0.4（-0.7至-0.2）分。4比特时，答案槽偏移从0.15升至0.53（0.6B）和从0.07升至0.12（1.7B）；相同权重信噪比下的高斯噪声分别为0.15和0.37（两次采样）及0.19（一次采样），因此无法确定舍入是否引入了超出等功率噪声的槽偏移。翻转率上升但低于独立均匀错误的精度匹配基线。对四个循环顺序求平均可在4比特下为0.6B模型恢复+12.6分（fp16下+5.3分）。我们将比特和遍次统一为机器无关单位：读取的权重字节数乘以遍次数。在成本匹配对中，额外顺序优于额外比特仅当权重有6位及以上时，决策表简化为：使用6比特权重，将剩余预算分配给最多四个顺序，每次一遍。所有实验均在两个小模型上使用最简量化器模拟完成；标题级搜索未发现此前关于量化与选项顺序联合研究的文献。

summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.
title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding

summary: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.
title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
title_translated: EngineAgent：具有推理栈层次感知与硬件能力的设备端大模型推理引擎代理化
summary_translated: 快速演进的大规模语言模型（LLM）架构和异构移动硬件使得在设备端推理引擎中支持新模型成为一个反复出现且成本高昂的系统挑战。每个模型可能需要在转换、图构建、算子和硬件后端之间进行协调变更。现有的编码代理通常忽略这些跨层依赖关系，并难以诊断主机-设备执行路径中的故障。我们提出了EngineAgent，一个用于自动化设备端LLM模型启用的智能体系统。其核心思想是将可复用的引擎和硬件知识与特定模型的实现相分离。在启用前，EngineAgent构建一个层次感知的引擎索引，以捕捉引擎抽象层和跨层依赖关系，并使用已支持的模型预先验证后端特定的构建、执行和调试工作流。对于每个新模型，构建者利用这些知识协调跨层变更，而审计者则检查实现完整性并通过设备端验证驱动迭代调试。在涵盖三个移动LLM和四种引擎-后端组合（CPU、GPU、NPU）的12个任务中，EngineAgent在两种底层LLM下实现了75%的端到端成功率，远高于最强编码代理基线的33.3%。成功需满足编译、设备端执行以及输出logit与参考实现的一致性。EngineAgent还相对于使用相同底层LLM的基线，降低了每项任务的平均耗时和模型API成本。

summary: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change. We separate the two on Chatbot Arena, a public platform where people compare answers from two anonymous large language models (LLMs) and pick the better one or say both are bad. We study 1,260,967 blind votes cast from May 2023 to August 2024 on pairs of models whose versions are fixed: dated vendor snapshots and models with fixed open weights. For the same pair of unchanged models, the share of votes saying "both are bad" rises by 1.71 percentage points a month on a mean of 17.1%, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024. In fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, it rose in every one, from 15.5% to 23.3%. The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote. It holds with prompt controls, in every major language, for dated vendor snapshots, open-weight models and models with stable answer length, and between interface changes. The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs. Platform-wide, the average model would be expected to score 78% against the 2023 average, yet the share of "both are bad" votes ended near where it began. The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining. Absolute verdicts on AI drifted while relative comparisons held steady, an evaluation drift that matters for LLM leaderboards and for the human feedback used to train models.
title: AI Isn't Getting Dumber, We're Getting Pickier: Rising Standards in Human Evaluation of Large Language Models

summary: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.
title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making

title_translated: MMDM：大规模多任务决策能力测量
summary_translated: 系统1型决策模型在单次前向传播中直接对查询指定的选项做出结构化概率决策，无需自回归生成推理轨迹或文本响应。近期评估覆盖多样任务，但往往依赖现有基准，而先前接触测试材料可能导致泛化能力被掩盖。此外，现实世界中的决策常涉及长上下文、大规模选项空间和复杂逻辑依赖，这些挑战尚未在现有基准中同时充分体现。因此，我们提出MMDM（大规模多任务决策），一个包含5,448个高质量问题的基准，涵盖16个任务类别，结合新构建的任务与基于源文本重构和重写的内容，适用于单选、多选和软标签决策，在全新上下文中进行测试。它覆盖了代理状态跟踪、工具与技能选择、偏好判断、评分标准等真实场景，选项空间范围从2到1,024，输入长度可达64,817个token。借助MMDM，我们对28个决策模型进行了全面定量评估，发现许多模型在常识任务上表现良好，但在相互依赖的选项、约束决策和多选任务中表现不佳。例如，Perplexity Decider-V1.2在世界知识上的硬单选准确率达到78.75%，但在选项逻辑任务上仅为53.95%，在约束规划任务上仅为47.95%；所有模型中最佳的硬多选准确率为36.81%。这些结果凸显联合推理、约束感知选择和完整多选恢复是决策模型发展的关键优先方向，MMDM为此提供了测量进展的测试平台。

summary: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.
title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
title_translated: 集中式与分散式注意力头丢弃对自回归多步推理的破坏分析
summary_translated: 在长时间清醒状态下，哺乳动物新皮层网络会经历局部短暂的神经元静默期，称为关机状态。本文探讨了类似时空集中干扰如何影响自回归大语言模型（LLMs）的序列推理。我们在GSM8K基准上对两台8B模型（Qwen3-8B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）的250组配对推导进行评估，对比了集中爆发式注意力头掩码与预算匹配的分散独立同分布（i.i.d.）丢弃。集中爆发导致显著推理退化：在起始参数$/mathcal{B}=0.10$（调度约5.7%易受损头-令牌体积）时，Qwen3-8B的准确率从分散噪声下的91.2%降至爆发丢弃下的78.8%（Δ= -12.4百分点，McNemar精确p = 5.5 × 10⁻⁶），而LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct从84.0%降至76.8%（Δ= -7.2百分点，p = 0.0198）。相反，通过分层五分位匹配将相同的累计预算均匀分布在生成步骤中，退化程度显著减轻（Qwen保留91.2%，LLaMA保留84.0%）。在探索性因子分解实验（N=100）中，单步丢弃密度与单次调度抽样中的急性下降相关（Qwen下降10.0百分点，pₕₒₗₘ = 0.0425），而多标记连续性表现出不确定的累积趋势（下降7.0百分点，pₕₒₗₘ = 0.1892）。错误分析显示，Qwen的失败源于格式化响应中的推导错误（条件准确率下降11.4百分点），而LLaMA有22.2%的不一致损失缺乏最终答案格式行（条件差距缩小至-5.0百分点）。这些发现表明，自回归推理链对集中式结构性干扰特别脆弱，为Transformer架构的容错性提供了实证基准。

summary: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.
title: Thermodynamics of words

title_translated: 词语的热力学
summary_translated: 我们提出词语热化假说，认为在文学作品中，词语之间存在有效相互作用，推动它们趋向热化状态，其词频分布与瑞利-金斯（RJ）热化和凝聚现象一致。在此概念中，不同词语扮演经典振子（粒子）的角色，其词频或相关标记相当于能量层级上的填充因子。热化过程由系统总能量（即总词数/标记数）和总概率范数（即不同词数）守恒所表征。我们将该方法应用于分析16部文学作品，包括《圣经》、莎士比亚全集以及美国国家语料库数据。结果显示，有效系统能量极低，因而出现RJ凝聚现象，大量概率集中在最低能量状态，对应于大量仅出现一次或两次的稀有词。这种RJ凝聚现象在多模态光纤中的光传播及其他物理系统中亦被观察到。我们还将词语热化与最近提出的全球家庭财富热化相联系。应用经济领域的洛伦兹曲线、帕累托曲线和齐普夫曲线分析所选16个案例的词频分布，结果表明热化理论对真实数据具有极佳的描述能力。

summary: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. They must therefore decide what to write down and what to read back, and when to do either. Recent work has begun to use on-policy distillation (OPD) to make memory control part of the policy, relying on memory tools and compaction protocols that lie outside either model's pre-training. However, this weakens the distillation on both sides: the teacher cannot give useful guidance on an interface it has never used, and the student samples too few meaningful memory actions for that guidance to take effect. To study this problem, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym II (CAMG-II), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, AutoResearch, General, and Visual. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG-II provides ordinary Bash access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling the policy to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory across context replacements. We also introduce Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II (CAMP-II), which trains a single policy jointly across all five environments with fully asynchronous OPD to learn this file-based memory behavior directly from a frozen teacher with a prior for file operations. On CAMG-II, CAMP-II obtains 2.97 times the gain of the strongest OPD baseline. The memory behavior CAMP-II learns generalizes to two external benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, with improved success rates.
title: Coding Agent Memory Post-Training II: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via On-Policy Distillation

title_translated: 编码智能体记忆后训练II：通过策略内蒸馏解锁预训练文件操作在长时任务中的记忆潜力
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体越来越多地处理交互历史超过模型活跃上下文的长时任务。因此，它们必须决定记录什么以及何时读取，以及何时执行这些操作。近期工作开始使用策略内蒸馏（OPD）将记忆控制纳入策略中，依赖于模型预训练之外的记忆工具和压缩协议。然而，这削弱了双方的蒸馏效果：教师无法对从未使用过的接口提供有效指导，而学生样本太少有意义的记忆动作，导致指导难以生效。为研究该问题，我们引入了编码智能体记忆健身房II（CAMG-II），一个涵盖购物、编码、自动研究、通用和视觉领域的长时智能体强化学习环境套件。每个环境除了原生任务接口外，还提供普通Bash访问和持续存在的工作区，使策略能够在上下文替换期间创建、修改、搜索和重用文件作为记忆。我们还提出了编码智能体记忆后训练II（CAMP-II），通过完全异步的OPD，在所有五个环境中联合训练单一策略，直接从一个冻结的教师模型中学习基于文件的记忆行为，该教师模型具有文件操作先验知识。在CAMG-II上，CAMP-II相较于最强的OPD基线提升了2.97倍。CAMP-II学习到的记忆行为在两个外部基准测试（Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-Bench Pro V2）中表现出泛化能力，成功率得到提升。

summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but raise significant privacy concerns due to their abilities to infer sensitive personal information from images with high precision. While current LVLMs are relatively well aligned to protect universal privacy, e.g., credit card data, we argue that privacy is inherently personalized and context-dependent. This work pivots towards a novel task: can LVLMs achieve Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection (ITP$^3$), allowing users to dynamically specify privacy boundaries through language specifications? To this end, we present SPY-Bench, the first systematic assessment of ITP$^3$ ability, which comprises (1) 32,700 unique samples with image-question pairs and personalized privacy instructions across 67 categories and 24 real-world scenarios, and (2) novel metrics grounded in user specifications and context awareness. Benchmarking the ITP$^3$ ability of 21 SOTA LVLMs, we reveal that: (i) most models, even the top-performing o4-mini, perform poorly, with only $\sim$24% compliance accuracy; (ii) they show quite limited contextual privacy understanding capability. Therefore, we implemented initial ITP$^3$ alignment methods, including a novel Noise Contrastive Alignment variant which achieves 96.88% accuracy while maintaining reasonable general performance. These results mark an initial step towards the ethical deployment of more controllable LVLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/achernarwang/specify-privacy-yourself
title: Specify Privacy Yourself: Assessing Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Preservation Ability of Large Vision-Language Models

summary_translated: 大视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）展现出卓越的能力，但因其能以高精度从图像中推断敏感个人信息而引发重大隐私担忧。尽管当前LVLMs在保护通用隐私（如信用卡信息）方面相对对齐良好，但我们认为隐私本质上是个性化且情境依赖的。本工作转向一项新任务：LVLMs能否实现推理时个性化隐私保护（ITP$^3$），允许用户通过语言规范动态设定隐私边界？为此，我们提出了SPY-Bench，首个系统性评估ITP$^3$能力的基准，包含（1）32,700个独特样本，涵盖67类和24个真实场景的图像-问题对及个性化隐私指令；（2）基于用户规范和情境感知的新颖度量标准。对21个最先进的LVLMs进行基准测试发现：（i）大多数模型，包括表现最佳的o4-mini，表现不佳，合规准确率仅为约24%；（ii）其情境隐私理解能力极为有限。因此，我们实现了初步的ITP$^3$对齐方法，包括一种新型噪声对比对齐变体，达到96.88%的准确率，同时保持合理的泛化性能。这些结果标志着迈向更可控LVLM伦理部署的重要一步。代码与数据可在https://github.com/achernarwang/specify-privacy-yourself获取。

summary: In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. Reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. To clarify these differing accounts, we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP), a measure developed for this analysis. Using mixed-domain calibration data, we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain, compared with 15-24% across domains. To understand how this organization evolves during training, we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open MoE families. Neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings, while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. Building on these neuron-level perspectives, we further introduce RAMP-based Pruning (RAMPr) to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. At 75% neuron retention, RAMPr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. At 50% retention, our pruning method can reduce resident GPU memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/ydyjya/Neuron-Level-Specialization-in-MoE
title: Understanding Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Beyond Expert Boundaries

summary_translated: 在混合专家（MoE）模型中，专家专业化的本质仍存在争议。关于领域相关专家偏好的报告与将路由主要归因于标记身份或句法模式的分析相矛盾。为澄清这些不同观点，我们超越专家级路由，利用为该分析开发的路由感知幅度分析（RAMP）方法，研究神经元层面的领域专业化计算组织结构。使用多源领域校准数据，我们在同一领域的多源样本中识别出具有58%-74%重叠的领域专业化神经元集合，而在不同领域间仅15%-24%。为理解这种组织结构如何在训练过程中演化，我们追踪了三个完全开源的MoE家族在预训练和后训练阶段的神经元重要性变化。尽管专家级重要性排名相对稳定，神经元重要性在预训练检查点之间仍持续重组，而后训练则基本保留神经元排序。基于这些神经元层面的视角，我们进一步提出基于RAMP的剪枝方法（RAMPr），用于跨专家选择神经元以平衡多领域能力的保留。在保留75%神经元的情况下，RAMPr在六种模型上保持了原始全模型91%-98%的平均性能；在50%保留率下，我们的剪枝方法可减少36%-43%的驻留GPU内存，并有效提升批处理预填充吞吐量17%-39%。代码已公开于https://github.com/ydyjya/Neuron-Level-Specialization-in-MoE。

summary: Interpretability demonstrations often show that intervening on a group of neurons changes a model's answer. A recent example removes an 18-neuron group in Qwen3-32B and the model answers "Simba" instead of "Scar" to a two-hop Lion King riddle. Such a demonstration establishes that the group matters, but not how much of it is necessary, whether other groups could do the same, or whether the effect carries over to other inputs. We ask: when intervening on a group of neurons changes a model's answer, how much of that group is actually necessary? For every selected group we measure all 4,096 subsets of 12 MLP neurons. On a two-alternative capital task (Qwen3-0.6B), zero-ablating 12 selected neurons lowers the answer margin by 27% while random neurons barely change it, yet replacing the same neurons with their values from other questions also barely changes it: their activations are nearly constant across questions, and we find no evidence that they carry question-specific content. On two-hop relation chains, patching 12 neurons with activations from the first-hop question shifts the answer to the bridge entity (from Scar to Simba): the greedy answer starts with the bridge in 9/11 chains for Qwen3-1.7B, 9/11 for Llama-3.2-1B and 8/10 for Gemma-3-1B; random neurons never do. The full group is rarely necessary: a few neurons often suffice, and in many chains disjoint subsets each flip the answer on their own, in an exploratory analysis most often when the model is less confident. Group effects transfer to rephrasings of the same chain but are much weaker on other tested chains. We study neuron-level causal interventions and alternative subsets; we do not recover the full connectivity of circuits.
title: Are Causal Neuron Circuits Unique and Transferable?

summary_translated: 可解释性演示通常表明干预一组神经元会改变模型的答案。最近的一个例子是在Qwen3-32B中移除18个神经元，模型对一个两跳《狮子王》谜题的回答从“Scar”变为“Simba”。此类演示证明了该组的重要性，但并未说明其必要程度、其他组是否也能实现相同效果，或该效应是否能在其他输入上延续。我们提出的问题是：当干预一组神经元改变模型答案时，实际上需要多少这部分？对于每组选定的神经元，我们测量了全部4,096个12个MLP神经元的子集。在双选首都任务（Qwen3-0.6B）中，零消融12个选定神经元使答案置信度下降27%，而随机神经元几乎无影响；但用其他问题中的对应神经元值替换同样不会显著改变结果：这些激活值在不同问题间几乎恒定，我们未发现其携带特定问题内容的证据。在两跳关系链中，将12个神经元的激活值替换为第一跳问题的激活值，会使答案转向桥接实体（从Scar变为Simba）：在Qwen3-1.7B中9/11条链、Llama-3.2-1B中9/11条链、Gemma-3-1B中8/10条链中，贪婪答案以桥接实体开头；而随机神经元从不如此。完整组很少必要：少数神经元通常就足够，且在许多链中，不相交的子集各自独立翻转答案，探索性分析显示，这种情况最常出现在模型置信度较低时。组效应可迁移到同一链的改写版本，但在其他测试链上则弱得多。我们研究了神经元级因果干预和替代子集；我们并未恢复电路的完整连接结构。

summary: We present Walrus, a unified 8B speech-and-audio foundation model handling speech recognition (including code-switching and multi-talker speech), speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, text-to-speech, emotion recognition, audio captioning, and general audio understanding. Our main contribution is not a new architecture but a data-centric training recipe; we use a standard decoder-only backbone initialized from Gemma 4, so that gains can be traced to the data. For speech generation, Walrus predicts low-bitrate discrete speech tokens, and a lightweight token-to-waveform decoder converts them into high-fidelity audio. The recipe is a three-stage data curriculum that moves from broad multilingual data to multi-talker, code-switching, and domain-specific data. At each stage, task-aware and dataset-aware weighting balances tasks with very different token budgets and protects core skills from forgetting. Trained on over 600M samples covering more than 20 tasks and 100 languages, Walrus leads on most multilingual, multi-talker, and code-switching ASR, speech translation, and audio understanding benchmarks, outperforming both open speech language models of comparable size and dedicated task-specific models. On most benchmarks, it even matches or surpasses the $4\times$ larger Qwen3-Omni's performance. Results suggest that data engineering is a primary driver of quality in multi-task speech and audio modeling.

summary_translated: 我们介绍Walrus，一个统一的8B语音与音频基础模型，能够处理语音识别（包括代码切换和多人说话）、语音到文本和语音到语音翻译、文本到语音、情感识别、音频描述生成以及通用音频理解。我们的主要贡献并非新架构，而是以数据为中心的训练方案；我们使用标准的解码器-only骨干网络，从Gemma 4初始化，从而使性能提升可归因于数据。在语音生成方面，Walrus预测低比特率离散语音标记，再由轻量级标记到波形解码器将其转换为高保真音频。该方案采用三阶段数据课程，从广泛多语言数据逐步过渡到多人、代码切换和领域特定数据。在每个阶段，任务感知和数据集感知加权平衡了具有完全不同标记预算的任务，并防止核心技能遗忘。在超过6亿个样本上训练，覆盖超过20项任务和100种语言，Walrus在大多数多语言、多人和代码切换的语音识别、语音翻译及音频理解基准测试中领先，优于同等规模的开放语音语言模型以及专用任务模型。在多数基准上，甚至达到或超越四倍大的Qwen3-Omni的性能。结果表明，数据工程是多任务语音与音频建模质量的主要驱动因素。

summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal and embodied tasks, yet aggregate accuracy or consistency alone does not reveal whether a judge changes its verdict for the right reason. We propose State-Conditional Invariance (SCI), a reliability principle requiring a judge to remain stable under semantics-preserving changes in presentation while responding to causal interventions that change the task outcome. We instantiate SCI in GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark built from deterministic MiniGrid trajectories with aligned Full, evidence-removal, and counterfactual variants, plus presentation and representation probes. Across five diagnostic tasks, GridWM-Judge tests local perception, action-conditioned transitions, presentation stability, representation exchangeability, and Full-CF causal discrimination. Our diagnostic evaluations reveal heterogeneous failure modes, including sensitivity to evidence presentation and encoding, low activation on successful trajectories, and weak paired counterfactual discrimination. Perception-controlled analyses further indicate that visual grounding and objective recovery are substantial, model-dependent bottlenecks. These results motivate jointly reporting correctness, presentation stability, and causal sensitivity instead of relying on a single score.
title: Towards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics
