title_translated: 迈向可靠的视觉-语言模型裁判：状态条件不变性与呈现感知诊断
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地被用作多模态和具身任务的自动化裁判，但仅靠整体准确率或一致性无法揭示裁判是否因正确原因改变判决。我们提出了状态条件不变性（SCI），一种可靠性原则，要求裁判在呈现方式发生语义保持变化时仍保持稳定，同时对改变任务结果的因果干预作出响应。我们在GridWM-Judge中实现了SCI，这是一个基于确定性MiniGrid轨迹构建的模拟器基础诊断基准，包含完整的、证据移除和反事实变体，以及呈现和表示探测。在五个诊断任务中，GridWM-Judge测试了局部感知、动作条件转换、呈现稳定性、表示可交换性以及完整-反事实因果区分能力。我们的诊断评估揭示了异质性的失败模式，包括对证据呈现和编码的敏感性、成功轨迹上的激活水平低，以及弱配对反事实区分能力。感知控制分析进一步表明，视觉基础和目标恢复是显著的、依赖于模型的瓶颈。这些结果促使我们联合报告正确性、呈现稳定性和因果敏感性，而非依赖单一评分。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse applications, making both safety and utility essential for reliable deployment. Jailbreak attacks use diverse forms of adversarial prompting to bypass alignment safeguards and induce LLMs to generate harmful responses. Some representation-based defenses regulate internal activations using predefined steering directions or learned safety regions. However, adapting intervention to each input without a predefined representational target while limiting over-refusal remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation (TERM), an inference-time defense that uses prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations to guide adaptive modulation of the model's own residual updates. Attention patterns vary across prompts and decoding steps, making raw entropy values difficult to interpret as a consistent signal for intervention. We therefore calibrate attention entropy against each prompt's own prefill baseline to establish an input-specific reference for reducing unnecessary intervention on benign requests. Adaptive scale normalization and temporal accumulation then account for differences in deviation scale and persistence to determine intervention strength. The resulting signal controls bounded scaling of the model's own residual updates, without relying on a predefined safety direction. We compare our method with seven defenses on seven jailbreak attacks and two over-refusal benchmarks across Llama, Qwen, and Gemma models, including Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B. Results show our method improves jailbreak robustness while maintaining low over-refusal on benign safety-sensitive requests with modest inference overhead.
title: POEM: Output-Relative Block-Sparse Attention for Long-Context Prefilling

summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多样化应用中展现出强大的能力，因此在可靠部署中安全性和实用性都至关重要。越狱攻击通过多种对抗性提示绕过对齐防护机制，诱导LLMs生成有害响应。一些基于表示的防御方法使用预定义的引导方向或学习到的安全区域来调节内部激活。然而，在没有预定义表示目标的情况下适应每个输入，同时限制过度拒绝，仍然是一个挑战。本文提出了一种无需目标的熵引导残差调制（TERM）方法，这是一种推理时防御机制，利用提示校准的注意力熵偏差来指导模型自身残差更新的自适应调制。不同提示和解码步骤中的注意力模式差异使得原始熵值难以作为一致的干预信号进行解释。因此，我们将注意力熵相对于每个提示自身的预填充基线进行校准，建立输入特定的参考标准，以减少对良性请求的不必要的干预。自适应尺度归一化和时间累积则考虑偏差尺度和持续性的差异，以确定干预强度。由此产生的信号控制模型自身残差更新的有界缩放，而无需依赖预定义的安全方向。我们在Llama、Qwen和Gemma模型上，针对七种越狱攻击和两个过度拒绝基准，将该方法与七种防御进行了比较，涵盖从0.6B到32B的Qwen3模型。结果表明，该方法在提升越狱鲁棒性的同时，对良性安全敏感请求保持低过度拒绝率，并具有适度的推理开销。

summary: Tokenisers such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) shorten text by repeatedly merging an adjacent pair of symbols into a new one; fewer tokens mean less computation. We ask whether an efficient algorithm can choose $k$ merges that leave a string of length $n$ almost as short as possible; doing nothing is already within a factor $n$. We prove that, unless P = NP, no polynomial-time algorithm comes within a factor $c\,n/\log n$, for some constant $c>0$, already for one binary string and for BPE-style merges that replace every occurrence. The key idea is that $k$ merges form a grammar with $k$ rules: a vertex-cover gap becomes a grammar-size gap, which we amplify with relabelled copies, encode in binary and realise with explicit merges. For merges that may skip occurrences, a simple algorithm achieves $O(n/\log\log n)$, and no Karp reduction can prove hardness beyond order $n/\log n$ unless coNP $\subseteq$ NP/poly. Over a one-letter alphabet, both tokenisation problems left open by Kastreva et al. are strongly NP-complete on datasets with repeated strings.
title: Pair-Merge Tokenisation Is Hard to Approximate on Binary Strings and Strongly NP-Hard on Unary Datasets

summary_translated: 分词器如字节对编码（BPE）通过反复合并相邻符号对来缩短文本；更少的标记意味着更少的计算量。我们探讨是否存在高效算法能够选择k次合并，使长度为n的字符串尽可能短；不采取任何操作本身已处于n倍因子范围内。我们证明，除非P = NP，否则不存在多项式时间算法能接近c·n/log n因子（c > 0为常数），即使对于单个二进制字符串和替换所有出现的BPE风格合并也是如此。核心思想是：k次合并构成一个包含k条规则的语法：顶点覆盖差距转化为语法大小差距，我们通过重命名副本放大该差距，以二进制编码并用显式合并实现。对于可能跳过出现的合并，简单算法可达到O(n/log log n)，且除非coNP ⊆ NP/poly，否则任何Karp归约都无法证明超过n/log n阶的难度。在单字母字母表上，Kastreva等人未解决的两个分词问题在包含重复字符串的数据集上均为强NP完全。

summary: We present Darmok, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords. Unlike American-style crosswords, cryptic clues disguise an unmarked definition and compositional wordplay beneath a misleading surface reading, sparse grids leave nearly half of each word's letters unchecked, and tournament rules rank a grid with even a single wrong or blank square behind all error-free solutions regardless of speed. Competing alongside an elite human field at the 55th Times Crossword Championship in London, Darmok solved all seven championship puzzles error-free and finished faster than every human competitor in every round. It solved the Final puzzle in 6m 52s, a full 3m 13s ahead of the human champion.   Today's frontier AI models can on average solve a whole puzzle in a single try with comparable accuracy and speed. However, cloud API calls still stall, time out, trigger safety refusals, or get stuck in reasoning loops. To simultaneously achieve tournament-grade accuracy, speed, and reliability, Darmok cross-checks clues across three independent models in rounds; uses verified crossing letters to unlock harder clues; and uses a whole-puzzle model and dictionary lookups to fill any remaining gaps without overwriting confirmed words. This design maintained near-zero-error performance across a five-month daily evaluation period. Under normal benchmark conditions, removing backup models, fallback steps, or elaborate prompt instructions barely changes accuracy, making the architecture appear over-engineered. Yet during both the worst days of daily operation and a severe slowdown of our primary model in the live Championship Final, the backup paths carried the solve, showing that as foundation models master the average case, the central challenge in building complex AI systems shifts to resilience in the worst case.
title: Darmok: Championship Cryptic Crossword Solving via Constraint Tightening and Resilient Orchestration

summary_translated: 我们介绍了Darmok，首个在英国密语填字游戏中达到超人类表现的自动化系统。与美式填字游戏不同，密语线索在误导性的表面阅读下隐藏了未标记的定义和组合式文字游戏，稀疏网格导致每个单词几乎一半的字母未被检查，而比赛规则规定只要有一个错误或空白方格，即使速度更快，排名也落后于所有无误解法。在伦敦举行的第55届《泰晤士报》填字游戏锦标赛中，Darmok与精英人类选手同场竞技，以零错误完成全部七道锦标赛题目，并在每一轮均快于所有人类对手。它在决赛中耗时6分52秒完成，比人类冠军领先整整3分13秒。如今的前沿AI模型平均可在一次尝试中以相当的准确率和速度解决整个谜题。然而，云API调用仍会卡住、超时、触发安全拒绝或陷入推理循环。为了同时实现比赛级别的准确性、速度和可靠性，Darmok采用多轮跨三个独立模型交叉验证线索；利用已验证的交叉字母解锁更难线索；并使用整题模型和词典查询填补剩余空白，而不覆盖已确认的单词。这一设计在为期五个月的每日评估期间维持了近乎零错误的表现。在正常基准条件下，移除备用模型、回退步骤或复杂提示指令对准确率影响极小，使架构看似过度工程化。然而，在日常运行最糟糕的日子以及主模型在直播决赛中严重减速时，备用路径承担了解题任务，这表明当基础模型掌握平均情况时，构建复杂AI系统的核心挑战已转向最坏情况下的韧性。

summary: Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head's output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head's own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across-group). Split-half reliability demonstrates that the per-head intervention effect is resolvable in GPT-2 ($r_Δ= 0.80$) but attenuated in Pythia-160M (0.42) and Pythia-410M (0.53), whereas structural self-cosine reliability is near-perfect in all three ($r_{\text{stat}} > 0.99$); which statistic predicts its own intervention is model-dependent. In a pre-registered 3-arm by 8-seed paired factorial at $4.0 \times 10^8$ tokens per run (399,900,672 tokens), a fixed arbitrary rank-one direction does not differ from baseline (+0.0011 nats, $p = 0.197$), while self-directed removal lowers validation loss (-0.0029 nats, Holm-corrected $p = 0.0023$) and outperforms the fixed arbitrary control directly (-0.0040 nats, $p = 0.0018$). At 50.9M scale the training benefit requires the own-value direction rather than a fixed arbitrary one, but a large cosine alignment alone does not establish redundancy in frozen models.
title: Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design

title_translated: 注意力手术的合理性检验：基于表示动机设计的空模型与匹配干预
summary_translated: Transformer架构的修改常通过测量内部表示的统计量，观察其数值较大后进行架构上的移除，并报告性能提升。这种解释需要评估该统计量是否显著高于噪声水平、是否在几何空模型下仍存在，以及训练收益是否依赖于被移除的具体方向。本文提出三个可复用的检验方法，并应用于自注意力移除任务，即删除注意力头输出中与自身值向量对齐的部分。在九个多头预训练模型（共5,408个注意力头，参数量从124M到6.9B）中，早期位置因果空模型解释了48%至63%的头-值余弦对齐，且无单调尺度趋势。在分组查询注意力下，该对齐仅存在于每个头自身的键值组内，且跨组方向反转（组内+0.24至+0.27，跨组-0.11至-0.19）。半样本可靠性分析显示，每头干预效果在GPT-2中可分辨（r_Δ=0.80），但在Pythia-160M（0.42）和Pythia-410M（0.53）中减弱；而结构自余弦可靠性在三者中均接近完美（r_stat > 0.99）；预测自身干预效果的统计量因模型而异。在一项预先注册的3臂×8种子配对因子实验中（每轮4.0×10^8个token，总计399,900,672个token），固定任意秩一方向与基线无差异（+0.0011纳特，p=0.197），而自指向移除降低了验证损失（-0.0029纳特，Holm校正后p=0.0023），并直接优于固定任意控制（-0.0040纳特，p=0.0018）。在50.9M规模下，训练收益依赖于自身值方向而非固定任意方向，但大余弦对齐本身并不能证明冻结模型中的冗余性。

summary: Communities in the United States and around the world are contesting data centers, the physical infrastructure of AI. These disputes pose environmental justice issues: residents must weigh unevenly distributed burdens using evidence scattered across metrics, corporate claims, policy documents, and public testimony. A formative study with 10 users showed that dashboards and single-agent AI can settle questions before people examine that evidence. Here we present EJAI, a source-grounded system that links an interactive map, retrieved evidence, missing-data statements, and two stakeholder personas that allow people to inspect evidence and form their own policy recommendations. In a small functional benchmark of 21 queries, retrieved evidence supported 98.4% of factual claims and the system acknowledged missing evidence in 32 of 33 cases. Persona alignment carried a grounding cost: the Corporate Executive omitted some evidence that conflicted with its assigned priorities. In a within-subjects study, 15 participants acting as residents prepared for a simulated town hall. Some checked cited AI claims while treating map metrics as official, some made conditional recommendations with safeguards such as water-use disclosure, and some found the personas simplified or biased. Our results suggest that civic AI can support preparation for public reasoning when it makes evidence, gaps, and disagreement open to inspection, and that corpus imbalance and two-sided personas remain open justice concerns.
title: EJAI: Judgment-Preserving Civic AI for Data Center Environmental Justice
title_translated: EJAI：保持判断力的城市人工智能用于数据中心环境正义
summary_translated: 美国及全球各地社区正在质疑数据中心——人工智能的物理基础设施——的建设。这些争议引发环境正义问题：居民需在分散于各类指标、企业声明、政策文件和公众证词中的证据基础上权衡不均衡的负担。对10名用户的形成性研究显示，仪表板和单智能体AI可在人们查阅证据前就解决部分问题。本文提出EJAI，一种基于来源的系统，将交互式地图、检索出的证据、缺失数据声明以及两个利益相关方角色相结合，使人们能够检查证据并形成自己的政策建议。在包含21个查询的小型功能基准测试中，检索出的证据支持了98.4%的事实性陈述，系统在33个案例中的32个承认了证据缺失。角色对齐带来了一定的根基成本：企业高管角色忽略了与其既定优先事项冲突的部分证据。在一项被试内研究中，15名参与者扮演居民，为模拟镇议会会议做准备。部分人核查了AI引用的主张，同时将地图指标视为官方数据；部分人提出了带有保障措施（如披露用水量）的条件性建议；部分人认为角色简化或存在偏见。结果表明，当公民AI能公开呈现证据、缺口和分歧时，可有效支持公共推理的准备；但语料不平衡和双面角色仍是待解的正义议题。

summary: Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. Experimental results on a pedestrian dataset demonstrate that DFIO reduces mean absolute and one-second relative translation errors by 13.2% and 39.6% relative to the TLIO baseline, and by 7.7% and 17.4% relative to its pre-trained counterpart. Furthermore, evaluations on uncalibrated smartphone inertial data indicate that the proposed method effectively mitigates translational drift and maintains trajectory alignment under highly noisy sensor conditions. Source code will be made publicly available.
title: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry

title_translated: 用于惯性里程计的可微分滤波
summary_translated: 精确的惯性里程计对自主系统至关重要，但受传感器噪声和偏差积分影响，存在无法约束的漂移问题。在TLIO等方法中，神经伪测量是独立于下游滤波器进行训练的。本文提出用于惯性里程计的可微分滤波（DFIO），一种将误差状态卡尔曼滤波更新阶段直接嵌入计算图的学习框架。在独立预训练后，DFIO通过可微测量更新，联合优化位移和协方差输出头，采用后验位置监督。所提系统在包含校准与未校准惯性测量的公开行人运动数据集上进行了验证。在行人数据集上的实验结果表明，相较于TLIO基线，DFIO将平均绝对误差和一秒相对平移误差分别降低13.2%和39.6%，相较于其预训练版本则分别降低7.7%和17.4%。此外，在未校准智能手机惯性数据上的评估表明，该方法能有效缓解平移漂移，并在高度噪声传感器条件下维持轨迹对齐。源代码将公开发布。

summary: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.
title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage

title_translated: 评估Transformer的组合泛化能力：组合等价性与模块覆盖的作用
summary_translated: 组合泛化是一种重要的分布外泛化形式，定义为在某些模块组合（如排序、过滤等功能）上训练后，能够推广到未见过的组合。尽管已有大量实证研究评估Transformer的组合泛化能力，但结果不一致，原因在于评估通常基于有限且随意设定的训练-测试划分。通过系统性评估，我们识别出两个强烈影响性能的关键训练-测试分布特征：组合等价性和模块覆盖度。我们发现，直接模型（仅在最终输出上训练）的表观性能主要源于利用组合等价性，即不同模块序列虽路径不同，但最终函数相同。当基准测试消除此类等价性后，性能显著下降，表明其无法泛化到已知模块的新组合所产生的新颖端到端函数。我们进一步证明，随着模块覆盖度偏移增加（训练与测试中模块出现上下文不同），性能单调下降，这对直接模型和逐步模型（在中间与最终输出上训练）均有影响。这些发现对基准设计具有明确启示：包含组合等价性的基准可能导致直接模型泛化能力的严重高估；同时包含模块覆盖违规与组合等价性的基准会加剧捷径学习。作为案例研究，我们展示了组合等价性在预训练模型Llama3-8B于编码基准LiveCodeBench的代码输出预测任务中的泛化表现中的作用。

summary: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.
title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling

title_translated: 利用心理物理学注意分布实现注视增强的奖励建模
summary_translated: 将人类反馈整合进语言模型以对齐模型输出与人类偏好，已成为日益受到关注的方法，其中基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是主流的偏好对齐框架。近期研究将眼动追踪（ET）数据作为额外监督信号用于奖励模型训练，使奖励学习建立在人类阅读行为的基础上。在此基础上，我们扩展了以往以注视为中心的模型，利用认知心理学中关于人类字母识别的成熟发现。具体而言，我们将视觉注意建模为以当前注视点为中心的空间梯度分布，并将其引入奖励模型训练过程。实验结果表明，使用所提出的注视分布训练的奖励模型，在偏好预测准确率上优于基线模型。此外，部分实验结果与人类阅读过程中注意力分配的既有发现定性一致，表明该方法可能捕捉到了人类注意力分配中具有认知意义的方面。

summary: Spoken Language Diarization (SLD) models provide frame-level language information of a speech recording. SLD modeling pipeline includes feature extraction from pre-trained speech models followed by clustering. Fine-tuning pre-trained speech models has shown performance gains for SLD with its magnitude being dataset dependent. Off-target Posterior Mass (OTPM), computed based on posterior language identification probabilities is proposed as a diagnostic metric to forecast performance gains from SLD fine-tuning. OTPM obtains positive correlation with probe gains, 0.56 on unseen synthetic bilingual data and 0.23 on real-world corpora. These results indicate promising potential of OTPM as a diagnostic metric for SLD.
title: Off-target posterior mass: A training-free diagnostic for fine-tuning spoken language diarization probes

title_translated: 非目标后验质量：一种无需训练的语音语言分离探针微调性能诊断方法
summary_translated: 语音语言分离（SLD）模型可提供语音录音的帧级语言信息。SLD建模流程包括从预训练语音模型中提取特征，随后进行聚类。微调预训练语音模型在SLD任务中已显示出性能提升，其提升幅度依赖于数据集。本文提出了一种基于后验语言识别概率的非目标后验质量（OTPM）作为诊断指标，用于预测SLD微调的性能增益。OTPM与探针性能增益呈正相关，在未见的合成双语数据上相关系数为0.56，在真实语料库上为0.23。这些结果表明OTPM具有作为SLD诊断指标的潜在前景。

summary: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.
title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
title_translated: 免费不确定性：通过粒子解码获得的序列级Rényi熵用于自适应大语言模型推理
summary_translated: 对大语言模型（LLM）完整生成过程中的不确定性进行量化，对于选择性预测和自适应计算至关重要。现有的零成本信号如平均词元熵和对数概率局限于单个词元或单一生成结果，而自一致性方法需要额外生成大量完成结果。本文表明，用于幂采样的序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）解码已经估计了幂分布的归一化常数，从而以零边际成本获得模型生成分布的序列级Rényi熵（SRE），且在每个粒子预算下均有保证。Rényi链规则将该读出扩展到任意阶的逐步熵族。我们证明，高于一阶的熵与每一步最可能的词元相关，这解释了为何它们与对数概率一致；而阶数为1/2的成员则累积了每步搜索努力的对数。该成员在13种设置中的10种中是最优的零成本选择性预测信号。在MATH500数据集上，其AUROC比对数概率高出0.022至0.044，四种模型均适用，且在不同长度四分位内保持一致。一个8粒子探测器能识别出需要更多粒子的问题，而两轮策略在MATH500上以34.2%更少的粒子达到了64粒子的准确率，覆盖三个随机种子。

summary: A reader can struggle to read in only one of their languages, and one proposed reason is how predictably spelling maps to sound. We measure that predictability as conditional entropy, the pronunciation uncertainty left once the spelling is seen, at two grain sizes (unit sizes): the alignment unit, an aligned spelling-sound chunk, and the syllable, bounded in the pronunciation. We analyse word lists in twelve alphabetic orthographies and report five in full, with English pronunciations from a dictionary and the rest from the synthesizer eSpeak-ng, length marks removed. Among the five, English has the most uncertainty and Finnish the least at both grains. Across all twelve, Portuguese and Danish exceed English per alignment unit, and German and Italian order differently by grain and transcription. These orders hold when English is transcribed by eSpeak-ng with u allowed to spell /j/ plus a vowel. Uncertainty per unit has no shared direction as units grow: it falls in Spanish and, less securely, German, is level in Finnish, depends on transcription in Italian and on the word list in English, and rises in Norwegian and Swedish. Summed uncertainty per word falls in all twelve, but that score is handed the pronunciation's boundaries and mixes context with in-sample memorisation, so it is no evidence of what a reader computes. An exact identity states when discarded spelling boundaries could reverse that fall. A uniform 20,000-word English sample holds 35% of the dictionary's syllable spellings and has syllable entropy 0.098 bits lower, so lexicons must be matched in size. In an exploratory check over eleven languages, syllable-scale entropy tracked first-year reading accuracy (rho = -0.74, falling to -0.25 if English is given the lowest entropy instead), without separating the syllable scale from the alignment unit. These estimates describe sampled writing systems, not readers.
title: Orthographic depth at two scales, with English also matched for lexicon size

summary_translated: 读者可能仅在一个语言中阅读困难，一种可能的原因是拼写与发音之间的可预测性。本文在两个粒度级别（单位大小）上测量这种可预测性：对齐单元（拼写-发音对齐块）和音节（受发音边界限制）。分析了十二种拼音文字的词表，其中五种完整报告，英语发音来自词典，其余来自合成器eSpeak-ng（去除长度标记）。在五个语言中，英语在两个粒度上的不确定性最高，芬兰最低。在全部十二种语言中，葡萄牙语和丹麦语在每个对齐单元上的不确定性超过英语，而德语和意大利语在不同粒度和转写方式下排序不同。当英语使用eSpeak-ng转写且允许/u/表示/j/加元音时，上述顺序依然成立。随着单位增大，单位不确定性方向不一致：西班牙语下降，德语下降较不显著，芬兰持平，意大利语取决于转写方式，英语取决于词表，挪威语和瑞典语上升。单词总不确定性在所有十二种语言中均下降，但该得分受到发音边界的干扰，并混合了上下文信息与样本内记忆，因此不能反映读者实际计算过程。一个精确恒等式指出，若丢弃拼写边界，该下降趋势可能逆转。一个统一的20,000词英语样本包含词典中35%的音节拼写，音节熵低0.098比特，因此词汇量必须匹配。在十一种语言的探索性检查中，音节尺度熵与一年级阅读准确率相关（rho = -0.74），若将英语设为最低熵，则相关性降至-0.25，且无法区分音节尺度与对齐单元。这些估计描述的是抽样书写系统，而非读者本身。

summary: Lenses that decode hidden states into words are a popular way to look inside language models, but a heatmap of decoded words only shows what a vector reads as and cannot distinguish whether, or how much, the model uses the information. We present an interactive viewer that puts reading, tracing and editing on the same layers-by-tokens grid of the residual stream. In the viewer, every cell can be decoded with two lenses, the logit lens and the Jacobian lens (J-lens), traced back to the tokens it drew from, and edited, with the rest of the model rerun on the spot. We demonstrate three usage scenarios on Gemma-3-4B-it, backed by sweeps over a few hundred prompts, to show what this tool can discover. First, the two lenses give different directions to write with, each suiting a different edit: the logit lens's word direction sets what a token outputs, while the J-lens's direction changes what later tokens read. Second, in two-hop trivia questions (the capital of the state or country containing a given city), the state or country is readable at the city token from as early as layer 7, and swapping it there can redirect the answer 92-98% of the time; however, at the answer position, the state or country information is not used. Third, when a chat model answers questions with a step-by-step reasoning prompt, the correct answer is often already the top word in the residual stream before any reasoning is written: for 89-92% of retrieval questions and 39-63% of multi-hop and serial ones, far above their respective distractors (at most 5%). However, ordering puzzles are an exception, as the model works them out only once it writes its final reasoning steps. Furthermore, for answers that are visible in the residual stream, the J-lens reads them a layer or two earlier than the logit lens across the different types of question.
title: MicroLens: Read, Trace, and Rewire the Residual Stream with Two Lenses

title_translated: MicroLens：用两个透镜读取、追踪并重连残差流
summary_translated: 将隐藏状态解码为词语的透镜是观察语言模型内部机制的常用方法，但解码词的热力图仅显示向量读取的内容，无法判断模型是否使用了该信息或使用程度。我们提出一个交互式可视化工具，将读取、追踪和编辑功能统一在残差流的层-词元网格上。在该工具中，每个单元可通过两个透镜——逻辑透镜和雅可比透镜（J透镜）进行解码，追溯其来源词元，并可进行编辑，同时模型其余部分即时重新运行。我们在Gemma-3-4B-it上展示了三种使用场景，基于数百个提示的扫描验证了该工具的发现能力。首先，两个透镜提供了不同的编辑方向：逻辑透镜的方向决定词元输出内容，而J透镜的方向改变后续词元的读取内容。其次，在两跳 trivia 问题（如某城市所在州或国家的首府）中，州或国家信息在城市词元处最早从第7层即可读取，此时替换该信息可使答案正确率达92%-98%；然而在答案位置，该信息并未被使用。第三，当聊天模型使用逐步推理提示回答问题时，正确答案往往在任何推理写出前就已是残差流中的首选词：在89%-92%的检索类问题和39%-63%的多跳及串行问题中，远高于对应干扰项（最多5%）。但排序谜题例外，模型仅在写出最终推理步骤后才解决。此外，对于残差流中可见的答案，J透镜比逻辑透镜提前一到两层读取。

summary: Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request's KV cache. We present Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. TKNP distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. The active node holding a block executes its projections and MLP for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism, while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident KV cache. This extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights: only current-token activations cross the network, dense all-reduces remain within NVLink, and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on Llama 3.1 405B and Nemotron-4 340B on up to 64 H100 GPUs, TKNP improves completion throughput for long-context, high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7$\times$ over DCP and by up to 2.06$\times$ over data parallelism at matched GPU count.
title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding

title_translated: 解码令牌并行：面向可扩展大语言模型解码的内存高效分布式注意力并行
summary_translated: 在高并发和长上下文场景下部署大型语言模型，需要随解码池规模增长的KV缓存容量和注意力带宽。现有并行化策略在两者之间权衡：数据并行复制模型权重，限制KV容量；张量并行在模型KV头数量处停止扩展，并在节点间执行密集通信；解码上下文并行（DCP）通过分片序列恢复容量，但增加了跨节点的部分注意力结果聚合。我们观察到解码过程中，密集层与注意力的扩展特性不同：密集层可通过批处理摊薄权重读取，在单个NVLink域内高效运行，而注意力开销随每个活跃请求的KV缓存增长。我们提出解码令牌并行（TKNP），一种解码池架构，将权重放置与注意力所有权解耦。TKNP将单个模型副本均衡分布在各节点的层块中。持有某块的活跃节点使用节点内张量并行对全批量执行投影和MLP，而每个节点在其本地驻留的KV缓存上计算自身请求的注意力。该方法在不复制权重的情况下实现跨节点的请求局部注意力：仅当前词元激活跨网络传输，密集全部归约仍限于NVLink内，注意力无需跨节点合并部分结果。在vLLM中实现，并在Llama 3.1 405B和Nemotron-4 340B上评估，最多使用64块H100 GPU时，TKNP在长上下文、高并发工作负载下，相比DCP提升完成吞吐量达1.7倍，相比数据并行提升达2.06倍（GPU数量相同）。

summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint's increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each component's original direction and pairwise angles ranging from 88.04 to 92.41 degrees; its exported BF16 student's increment has 4.90% outside energy, versus 10.52% for the sum of saved FP32 components. The same checkpoint achieves a 32.72% macro score across six benchmarks, compared with 32.44% for its initial task-arithmetic merge. These measurements describe geometry and capability at the evaluated training stages and settings.
title: Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 面向多教师在线蒸馏的领域路由增量优化
summary_translated: 多教师在线蒸馏为每个样本分配一个领域教师，但通常仅更新共享的学生参数。我们提出领域路由增量优化（DRD-MOPD），明确指定每个领域样本所更新的参数组件。学生模型由一个冻结的基础部分和从专家减去基础权重初始化的可训练组件组成。所有组件在每次前向传播中均参与计算；四种更新模式定义了样本领域与组件之间的对应关系，每种模式具有独立的优化器状态。我们分析了这些更新规则，并通过角度、投影系数和能量来衡量原始专家几何结构的保留程度。先前工作如Open-MOPD直接从基础模型蒸馏；其发布的最终检查点中97.02%的增量能量位于原始专家方向张成空间之外。相比之下，我们的自建检查点在20次更新后，沿各组件原始方向的系数接近1，成对角度范围为88.04至92.41度；其导出的BF16学生模型的增量能量仅有4.90%位于外部，而保存的FP32组件之和为10.52%。同一检查点在六个基准测试上取得32.72%的宏得分，优于初始任务算术合并的32.44%。这些测量结果描述了在评估训练阶段和设置下的几何结构与能力表现。

summary: We investigate how Latin American Studies (LAS) has evolved since 1982 in three leading LAS journals. Using network analysis, text mining, and bibliometrics, we trace transformations in disciplinary positioning, authorship, and citation patterns. Our main claim is that LAS has undergone an assimilationist consolidation. The field is now institutionally recognisable, with core LAS journals occupying central positions in disciplinary networks and acting as bridges across fields. Yet this consolidation has reinforced hierarchies privileging Anglophone academic norms. Journals based in Latin America, once central, have been marginalised. The share of Latin American authors has grown, but their profiles converge towards Northern standards.
title: Latin American Studies since the 1980s: From Apocalyptic Dreams to Assimilationist Consolidation
title_translated: 1980年代以来拉丁美洲研究：从末世幻想到同化主义整合
summary_translated: 我们研究了自1982年以来三个主要拉丁美洲研究（LAS）期刊中该领域的演变。通过网络分析、文本挖掘和文献计量学方法，追踪了学科定位、作者构成和引用模式的变化。我们的核心观点是，LAS已经历同化主义整合。该领域现已成为制度性认可的学科，核心LAS期刊在学科网络中占据中心位置，并作为跨学科桥梁发挥作用。然而，这种整合强化了偏袒英语学术规范的等级结构。曾居核心地位的拉美本土期刊已被边缘化。拉美作者的比例虽有所上升，但其学术形象正趋同于北方标准。

summary: Expert parallelism (EP) shards the experts of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer across GPUs, so every MoE layer requires two all-to-all communications, namely dispatch and combine. Compared with training, inference processes relatively few tokens per GPU at a time, and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens, rather than data movement, dominate the latency. We present NVLinkOneSided, a one-sided EP all-to-all for GPUs within a single NVLink domain. Each source rank pushes its tokens, without first exchanging metadata, into rank-major buffers on the target GPUs, and the grouped GEMMs read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. We provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires, namely Fence and Sentinel, for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. On Blackwell GPUs, NVLinkOneSided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0$\times$ faster than DeepEP, with the largest speedups at small batch sizes. The resulting MoE layer is up to 2.4$\times$ faster than DeepEP with DeepGEMM. It even outperforms the fused DeepGEMM MegaMoE at up to 128 tokens per GPU, making it still competitive for decoding. We expose NVLinkOneSided through a modular interface, so that it is agnostic to the activation quantization format, decoupled from the MoE compute backend and easy to integrate into inference frameworks.
title: One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink

title_translated: 基于NVLink的单边专家并行全对全通信用于混合专家模型推理
summary_translated: 专家并行（EP）将混合专家（MoE）层中的专家分片到多个GPU上，因此每个MoE层需要两次全对全通信，即分发和汇聚。与训练相比，推理阶段每个GPU处理的token数量较少，且在小批量情况下，固定开销不随token数量增长，而非数据移动成为延迟主导因素。我们提出NVLinkOneSided，一种适用于单个NVLink域内GPU的单边EP全对全通信方案。每个源节点直接推送其token至目标GPU的秩主缓冲区，无需先交换元数据，分组GEMM操作直接在原位读取数据，而非从每个专家的副本中读取。我们提供了两种同步协议——Fence和Sentinel，分别适用于高吞吐和低延迟场景。在Blackwell GPU上，NVLinkOneSided完成分发和汇聚的速度比DeepEP快1.2至3.0倍，尤其在小批量时速度提升显著。由此产生的MoE层比DeepEP结合DeepGEMM快达2.4倍，甚至在每GPU最多128个token时仍优于融合的DeepGEMM MegaMoE，使其在解码任务中依然具备竞争力。我们通过模块化接口暴露NVLinkOneSided，使其与激活量化格式无关，与MoE计算后端解耦，易于集成到推理框架中。

summary: Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model's errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse's share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa <= 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.
title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies

title_translated: 达成一致答案却无法解释原因：大语言模型推理失败分类体系的测量局限性
summary_translated: 大语言模型推理失败分类体系正越来越多地被当作测量指标使用：论文报告模型错误落入特定类别比例，并在不同模型间进行比较。我们指出，对于某一类别的报告比例在很大程度上取决于测量过程本身。我们定义了组合坍缩（Compositional Collapse，即模型注意到问题所需的一个子部分后，却将其丢弃或误用），并在一个公开的多语言数学基准测试（包含2,316条评分记录）上对十二个模型和十一种语言进行了测量。首先，50.1%的错误同时符合多个类别，因此报告的多数类别依赖于分类器测试的顺序：调换两个测试顺序后，在十二个模型中有十一个发生改变，且在所有六种顺序下，组合坍缩的占比在26.4%至76.4%之间波动。其次，类别判断的共识崩溃，但任务层面的共识保持稳定。所有十一种语言的母语者对179段转录进行评判，他们与我们的检查员在答案正确性上达到kappa=0.932，但在组合坍缩判断上仅kappa=0.093。第二位母语者重新评分142项，其中121对确定性样本两人间一致性为kappa=0.659，但各自与检查员的一致性均不超过kappa=0.094。将同一检查员模型使用人类指令原文重跑后，其与人类2的一致性从kappa=0.147提升至0.636，说明差距主要源于提示设计而非模型本身。第三，检查员标记组合坍缩的频率是母语者的1.81倍，但若排除存在缺陷的基准项（孟加拉语和中文翻译中缺失的条款），则仅为1.17倍。我们建议在比较模型失败模式率之前进行四项低成本检查：报告标签共现情况、打乱优先级判定顺序、在共享独立样本上验证、审计系统性分歧。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. This perspective makes trajectory compatibility the central criterion for reference selection in multi-turn OPD. Experiments on ALFWorld and the airline domain of $τ^3$-bench show that LCS is the only evaluated reference selector to improve over reference-free OPD on both ALFWorld overall scores and all three airline metrics. Without further optimization, the airline-trained models also transfer to the retail domain, where LCS improves all three metrics.
title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 哪些成功能成为良好参考？用于多轮在线蒸馏的动作序列对齐
summary_translated: 在线蒸馏（OPD）通过监督学生在其自身轨迹上的表现，减少训练与推理分布差异。对于多轮工具使用智能体，将教师条件化为经过验证的同任务成功轨迹作为参考，可提供有用的事后洞察，但不同的成功路径可能进入不兼容的交互状态，导致误导性监督。我们将成功参考选择建模为自由目标最优传输问题，简化为将每个失败轨迹分配给最兼容的成功参考。由于潜在状态路径不可见，我们使用动作序列对齐作为兼容性的可观测代理，并采用最长公共子序列（LCS）实现，该方法识别动作的共享有序主干，同时允许可恢复的偏离。这一视角使轨迹兼容性成为多轮OPD中参考选择的核心标准。在ALFWorld和$τ^3$-bench的航空领域实验表明，LCS是唯一在ALFWorld整体得分和航空领域全部三项指标上均优于无参考OPD的参考选择器。未经进一步优化，航空领域训练的模型也能迁移到零售领域，LCS在所有三项指标上均有提升。

summary: Retrieval-augmented language model systems generally select context by query-conditioned relevance. We argue that long-lived AI systems require a second operator: activation-conditioned memory availability. We specify an architecture in which request and goal cues seed an authorized memory graph, activation and fan attenuation allocate a bounded traversal frontier, retrieved entities recursively emit cues, and a typed evidence graph is reconstructed before generation. The specification yields five architectural consequences about candidate selection, traversal control, graph regularization, evidence reconstruction, and reinforcement. We derive implementation-level cost estimates and define ablations, failure conditions, and a reproducible evaluation protocol. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if a simpler graph reranker matches full traversal on causal and temporal recovery under equal budgets. This architecture-and-analysis preprint reports no benchmark measurements. If the claim holds, retrieval returns the evidence path that makes a memory available, not only a ranked list.
title: Activation-Guided Graph Retrieval for Cognitive Memory Reconstruction in Language Model Systems

title_translated: 基于激活引导的图检索用于语言模型系统的认知记忆重建
summary_translated: 检索增强型语言模型系统通常根据查询条件相关性选择上下文。我们认为，长期运行的AI系统需要第二个操作机制：基于激活条件的记忆可用性。我们提出一种架构，其中请求和目标线索生成授权的记忆图，激活与扩散衰减控制有限的遍历边界，检索到的实体递归产生线索，并在生成前重构类型化的证据图。该规范带来了关于候选选择、遍历控制、图正则化、证据重构和强化学习的五个架构后果。我们推导出实现层面的成本估算，并定义了消融实验、失败条件和可复现的评估协议。如果更简单的图重排序器在相同预算下能实现因果和时间恢复的完整遍历，则核心论点将被缩小或证伪。该架构与分析预印本未报告基准测量结果。若论点成立，检索返回的是使记忆可用的证据路径，而不仅仅是排序列表。

summary: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. We evaluate ASPIRE on three measured systems: a mobile robot, a rotational system with dry friction, and a laboratory fermenter. Each system is tested with and without a description, in five runs per task. All 30 runs delivered valid models, at a cost of 0.96 to 3.38 US dollars per run. An assessment by the authors found that, for the 30 models recommended by the agent, one per run, the interpretation of the model and the documentation of its structure selection and parameter estimation fully satisfied 132 of 150 assessed items and partly satisfied 18. The most frequent discrepancy, found in nine models, concerned inaccurate or unsupported claims about model structure selection.
title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
title_translated: ASPIRE：用于迭代推理与探索的智能体系统辨识平台
summary_translated: 系统辨识需要专家对辨识方法的选择、先验物理知识的融合以及模型验证做出决策。我们提出了ASPIRE，一个用于非线性系统辨识的框架，其中大型语言模型代理负责选择并执行辨识方法。ASPIRE从测量数据中构建闭式、非线性静态或动态模型，可选地结合系统描述、模型预期用途及以形式化或自然语言表达的物理要求。每个模型包含其参数、估计记录、各项解释以及在代理不可见的测试数据上的误差评估。形式化的物理要求独立验证。ASPIRE可自主运行或交互式运行，允许代理提问，用户也可请求进一步分析和辨识轮次。我们在三个实测系统上评估ASPIRE：一台移动机器人、一个具有干摩擦的旋转系统，以及一个实验室发酵罐。每个系统均在有无描述的情况下进行测试，每项任务重复五次。所有30次运行均生成有效模型，每次运行成本为0.96至3.38美元。作者评估发现，在代理推荐的30个模型中（每轮一个），模型解释和结构选择与参数估计的文档完全满足150项中的132项，部分满足18项。最常见的差异出现在九个模型中，涉及模型结构选择的不准确或缺乏支持的声明。

summary: Inference-time sampling is a central mechanism for improving large language models, with temperature controlling the tradeoff between reliability and diversity. While recent work suggests that varying temperature across samples can improve multi-sample inference, simple fixed-temperature schemes remain the standard in practice. We investigate this discrepancy in the canonical pass@K setting, asking when temperature diversity is useful, and when a single tuned temperature suffices. To this end, we analyze per-question success probabilities across multiple models and datasets, tracking how they vary with sampling temperature. We identify several consistent properties of these profiles, including that harder questions are less likely to share efficient sampling temperatures, although this trend is only logarithmic in hardness. We then derive an efficient method for evaluating the theoretically optimal multi-temperature allocation scheme, and show that although such a scheme improves performance, its gains over single-temperature baselines are typically modest when temperature is tuned as a function of the sampling budget K. We explain this phenomenon through mathematical mechanisms that we call dulling effects, and show how they ensure the robustness of temperature choices across different question distributions. Our results clarify when multi-temperature sampling is useful, and how temperatures should ideally be chosen.
title: One Temperature to Rule Them All?

title_translated: 一个温度足以统御一切？
summary_translated: 推理时采样是提升大语言模型性能的核心机制，温度控制着可靠性与多样性之间的权衡。尽管近期研究指出在多样本推理中变化温度可提升效果，但实践中仍普遍采用简单的固定温度方案。我们针对经典的pass@K设置研究这一差异，探讨何时温度多样性有用，何时单一调优温度已足够。为此，我们分析了多个模型和数据集上各问题的成功概率随采样温度的变化情况。我们识别出这些曲线的若干一致特性，例如更难的问题更少共享高效的采样温度，尽管这种趋势仅在难度上呈对数关系。随后，我们推导出一种高效评估理论上最优多温度分配方案的方法，并表明虽然该方案能提升性能，但在温度随采样预算K调整时，其相对于单温度基线的增益通常较小。我们通过称为‘钝化效应’的数学机制解释这一现象，并展示其如何确保不同问题分布下温度选择的鲁棒性。我们的结果明确了多温度采样的适用场景，以及温度应如何理想地选择。

summary: Berglund and van der Merwe formalized byte-pair encoding and bounded how far an appended string can change a tokenization, leaving the converse open: how far can a string prepended on the left change it, which dictionaries make that ripple infinite, and can it be computed efficiently when finite? We answer all three for every dictionary. The origin radius, how far a prepend can change covering spans, is decided with radius certificates by a product of two runs of the automaton that guesses the final tokens, in time polynomial in the dictionary written out, and it is infinite exactly when one periodic word has two canonical tilings with no common boundary. Under their ordering condition it is infinite exactly when some rule (t, t) finds its two copies adjacent at its own stage, and such a rule makes any dictionary infinite. A finite radius makes every window of a width read off the radii have a cut, and the radius is finite exactly when such cuts are dense. The token machine completes for every dictionary, and the tokenization is subsequential, extending what Berglund, Martens and van der Merwe proved for proper ones under one pass per rule. A streaming tokenizer emits after every symbol exactly the tokens that no continuation changes, in polynomial time, answering a question of Dalirrooyfard and Ye. Boundedness of the label measure, the edit distance of the token sequences, is decided for every dictionary in polynomial time as well, and under the ordering condition the largest distance one edit causes over dictionaries of m rules lies asymptotically between m^2/10 and m^2/2. GPT-2's merge table carries 244 effective self-pairs, so its origin radius is infinite from the forty-second merge on, and that of cl100k, o200k and Llama 3 from their first. Every measured number is its program's output, and what is not executed is named.
title: The Left Ripple of Byte-Pair Encoding: Certified Lookbehind for Every Dictionary

title_translated: 字节对编码的左向涟漪：适用于每个词典的认证回溯
summary_translated: Berglund和van der Merwe形式化了字节对编码，并界定了附加字符串对分词影响的范围，但留下了相反问题：左侧添加字符串最多能改变多少分词？哪些词典会导致这种涟漪无限？当其有限时能否高效计算？我们对每个词典回答了这三个问题。起源半径（即前置字符串可改变覆盖跨度的距离）可通过两个自动机运行的乘积，利用半径证书决定，时间复杂度在词典展开后为多项式级别；当且仅当某个周期性单词存在两种无共同边界的规范铺砌时，该半径为无穷。在他们的排序条件下，当某规则(t, t)在其自身阶段找到两个相邻副本时，半径为无穷，且此类规则会使任意词典变为无穷。有限半径意味着每个宽度窗口读取半径后均有断点，且半径有限当且仅当此类断点稠密。令牌机对每个词典均可完成，分词为子序列，扩展了Berglund、Martens和van der Merwe对正规词典在每规则单遍下的结论。流式分词器在每个符号后立即输出不会被后续延续改变的令牌，可在多项式时间内完成，回应了Dalirrooyfard和Ye提出的问题。标签测度（即令牌序列间的编辑距离）的有界性对每个词典也可在多项式时间内判定；在排序条件下，单次编辑在m条规则的词典中引起的最大距离渐近位于m²/10与m²/2之间。GPT-2的合并表包含244个有效自对，因此从第42次合并起其起源半径为无穷，cl100k、o200k和Llama 3则从首次合并起即为无穷。所有测量数值均为程序输出，未执行的部分被命名。

summary: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.
title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: GTAGym：用于评估与强化学习的真实AAA游戏任务环境
summary_translated: AAA游戏为评估智能体感知、推理与控制提供了丰富的测试平台。然而，评估智能体是否能在AAA游戏中完成任务具有挑战性，通常依赖人工标注，因为任务结果往往难以自动验证，更不用说用于强化学习（RL）。我们引入GTAGym，一个用于GTA V任务评估与强化学习的环境与框架。其评估基准GTAVBench源自GTA V主线任务，包含103个在线任务，涵盖九类任务家族，以及47个基于GTA V图像的射击与狙击任务。一个网络服务器提供对在线环境和评估界面的访问，支持通过截图和键盘鼠标操作进行并行测试，并自动检查引擎状态结果。我们在GTAVBench上对六种前沿大语言模型进行了评估，使用文本任务指令；在GTAVBench-AGI分支中，指令仅出现在首张截图中，且由工具自动压缩交互历史。最佳配置在GTAVBench-AGI中达到70.9%的整体准确率，但空中导航、规避与拦截仍具挑战。GTAGym还提供可扩展的生成器，可在用户指定范围内按固定模板采样任务参数，生成批量的3D与图像射击环境用于RL，具备自动奖励与终止信号。在生成的步行导航任务上对Qwen3.8-27B进行LoRA RL训练，提升了域内表现，并成功迁移到域外任务类别，使原生GTA V任务成功率从15%提升至23%。

summary: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. Because they are generated from the available repository rather than requiring a known bug-free version, they can be produced automatically for reproducible application states without manual image annotation. We evaluate the approach on a controlled benchmark derived from SWE-bench Multimodal by injecting visual UI bugs into a real web application. We vary screenshot degradation and reference-image provision and measure whether the coding agent identifies the correct source file. The results show that reference images improve file localization especially for degraded image quality, increasing the gold file match rate under fourfold downsampling with JPEG compression. We confirmed with further analysis that the proposed approach recognizes text approximately 12 percentage points better than language biased OCR under the same degradation.
title: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
title_translated: 基于代码库上下文的图像理解用于智能体化软件开发
summary_translated: 编码智能体越来越多地接收作为错误报告一部分的UI截图，但低分辨率、压缩伪影或小字号文本导致的图像质量下降会阻碍它们识别相关的UI元素和源文件。随着图像质量恶化，视觉-语言模型的可靠性降低，而依赖OCR的方法可能将劣质输入中的识别错误传播下去。当定位所需的视觉证据在查询截图中不再清晰可辨时，这两种方法都受到限制。我们提出为编码智能体增强代码库渲染的参考图像：从智能体需要修改的同一代码库生成的清晰截图。这些参考图像在保留当前可能包含错误的实现状态的同时，提供了应用程序UI的可读视觉证据。由于它们是从可用代码库生成的，无需已知无错版本，因此可以自动创建以实现可复现的应用程序状态，而无需手动图像标注。我们在一个由SWE-bench Multimodal衍生的受控基准上评估该方法，通过向真实Web应用注入视觉UI错误进行测试。我们改变截图退化程度和参考图像提供情况，并测量编码智能体是否能正确识别源文件。结果表明，参考图像尤其在图像质量较差时提升了文件定位效果，在JPEG压缩下四倍降采样条件下显著提高了黄金文件匹配率。进一步分析证实，在相同退化条件下，所提方法的文本识别准确率比语言偏向的OCR高出约12个百分点。

summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279+-0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon's (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.
title: Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows

title_translated: 看见并不等于相信：反事实病变擦除教会小型医学视觉-语言智能体仅报告图像所显示的内容
summary_translated: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常常因问题中提及某发现而报告该发现；标准基准未能捕捉这一现象。我们从公开的分割数据集中构建反事实视图，无需人工标注：通过修补技术擦除病变的视图、在同一形状下在其他位置进行控制编辑的视图，以及未编辑的无病变图像。证据敏感性差距（ESG）定义为擦除后出现“不存在”或“引用”回答的比率减去控制编辑后的比率；对于忽略图像或对两种编辑反应相同的模型，该值为零。MedScope-4B（Qwen3.5-4B，LoRA，图像工具）在标签衍生轨迹上训练，依据预先注册规则选择，并与九个前沿模型和六个开源VLMs进行一次测试；随后通过四项预先注册检查探查其机制。在507个内部病例（涵盖五种影像类型）中，MedScope-4B达到ESG 0.758，仅在9.6%的情况下声称被擦除的病变，而前沿模型分别为0.27–0.47和41–62%（所有p<0.001），且对真实病变的准确性未显著下降。若不使用反事实视图，ESG降至0.279±0.107（三个种子）；该效应在MedGemma 1.5 4B及两个未见过的修补工具上均重现。在四个外部中心，优势依然存在，但前沿模型检测到更多真实病变；在新的外部测试中，MedScope-4B在48张气胸影像中检测出0例，净效用低于gemini-4-argon（-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]）。匹配控制编辑未被证明重要；在三个种子下，未建立新外部ESG优势超过基于移除的DPO；成对视图一致性目标未能击败匹配计算控制，而仅延续该过程便在每个种子下降低了对未见工具的擦除病变声明，代价是敏感性在一处下降。在擦除和编辑图像上训练使小型模型获得一种基于证据的决策倾向，这是提示无法赋予前沿模型的；这并未提升感知能力，且罕见关键发现仍需覆盖。

summary: Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.
title: Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models

title_translated: 线性探测至贝叶斯流形：大语言模型中算术的几何结构
summary_translated: 线性探测是研究大语言模型（LLMs）激活中几何结构（如螺旋线、圆环）的标准方法，这类结构常被视为模型在进行相关计算的证据。然而，探测准确率本身无法确立这一点，因为它混淆了四个独立主张。它们分别是：(1) 概念可从激活中解码；(2) 激活形成特定形状；(3) 该形状属于所探测概念而非模型也表示的相关概念；(4) 模型输出依赖于该形状。我们将这些主张称为可解码性、形状、所有权和因果使用，并通过四阶段贝叶斯流程分别检验。第二阶段比较候选形状，仅当其证据超过预设阈值时才选择最佳形状。第三阶段提前移除一组相关概念，测试形状是拥有还是继承。第四阶段干预形状，检验模型输出是否依赖于它。我们将该流程应用于GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B和Pythia 6.9B中的两位数加法与乘法。几乎每个概念都可解码，但不同概念的解码方向高度重叠。几乎所有强支持的比较都选择了带变化半径的螺旋带（ribbon）或环面（torus）。在1330个具有所有权判断的神经元中，19%的形状为拥有，81%为继承。拥有与继承的形状对输出的影响程度相当。干预形状保留了约61%的完整探测干预效果，仅使用最多五个维度，而探测的中位数为九个。我们的结果表明，仅凭探测结论会夸大模型实际计算的内容，建议将探测结果报告为对所有四个主张的判断，而非单一准确率。

summary: Energy-based models (EBMs) assign a scalar energy to every joint value of the observed and predicted variables. In decision models, the prediction is chosen from a finite list of options provided with each input. Inference then reduces to comparing the energies of the options, and training lowers the energy of the correct option relative to the others. A complete decision must also account for the possibility that no option is acceptable. However, the energies learned by a standard EBM define only relative compatibility: adding the same input-dependent quantity to all energies leaves the predictions, the Gibbs distribution, and the usual training losses unchanged. The model therefore has no learned reference level against which to decide whether any option fits. We propose ZeroPoint, an EBM that makes the empty answer a state of the model with energy zero for every input. This fixed state provides an explicit reference for the energies of all listed options, whose non-negative depths measure their compatibility with the input relative to the empty answer. The options and the empty answer share one distribution, in which an option at zero depth receives no probability. The decision to select an option or to abstain is thus part of ordinary inference, trained with the negative log-likelihood loss, rather than a separate rejection rule. The energy function is a small multilingual encoder that reads the input together with all the options and is invariant to their order. Ablations show that most of the benefit comes from training with examples in which no option fits. With the same encoder and data, the fixed zero separates inputs with and without an acceptable option slightly better than a learned rejection class and clearly better than a thresholded softmax, while leaving the choice among options unchanged.
title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model
title_translated: ZeroPoint：轻量级基于能量的决策模型
summary_translated: 基于能量的模型（EBMs）为观测变量和预测变量的所有联合取值分配一个标量能量。在决策模型中，预测从每个输入提供的有限选项列表中选出。推理简化为比较各选项的能量，训练则降低正确选项相对于其他选项的能量。完整的决策还必须考虑没有任何选项可接受的可能性。然而，标准EBM学习的能量仅定义相对兼容性：向所有能量添加相同的输入相关量不会改变预测、吉布斯分布和常规训练损失。因此，模型没有学习到一个可用来判断任何选项是否合适的参考水平。我们提出ZeroPoint，一种将空答案设为模型状态且对每个输入能量恒为零的EBM。这一固定状态为所有列出选项的能量提供了明确参考，其非负深度衡量了选项相对于空答案与输入的兼容性。选项与空答案共享同一分布，其中深度为零的选项概率为零。因此，选择选项或放弃选择成为普通推理的一部分，通过负对数似然损失进行训练，而非单独的拒绝规则。能量函数是一个小型多语言编码器，读取输入及所有选项，且对选项顺序不变。消融实验表明，大部分收益来自在无合适选项示例上的训练。在相同编码器和数据下，固定零点比学习的拒绝类别略好地区分有无合适选项，明显优于阈值softmax，同时保持选项间选择不变。

summary: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? We address this question using a cross-persona paradigm across 14 model variants from two families (Llama 3 and Qwen 2.5, 0.5B-14B, base and instruct). Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. Across models, geometry strength is associated with behavioral amplification (r = 0.68, p = 0.008; partial r = 0.69 controlling for log size). To relate internal structure to output behavior, a matched activation-probing paradigm shows that probe slopes vary less than behavioral slopes (1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53). A synthetic control shows that ridge probing can inflate these slopes; after subtracting a baseline based on a reliability proxy from another analysis, adjusted slopes remain associated with behavior (r = 0.88). We term the measured probe-behavior gap readout attenuation. These results establish decodability and geometric alignment under the tested assays, without showing that the measured directions mediate the cross-persona answers.
title: Tracing Psychometric Inference in Large Language Models

title_translated: 追踪大语言模型中的心理测量推断
summary_translated: 大语言模型是否在内部表征心理构念，还是仅生成看似具有心理测量结构的输出？我们通过跨人物设定在来自两个系列（Llama 3 和 Qwen 2.5，0.5B–14B，基础版与指令版）共14种模型变体中回答此问题。给定来自真实个体（N = 272名台湾大学生）在某一心理量表上的响应，模型预测在另外六个量表上的响应。在行为层面，较大模型再现并放大了人类的跨量表相关性；在对七量表人类相关性进行测量衰减校正后，这种放大效应仍然存在。随后我们考察这种结构是否反映在内部。对比方向分析发现，较大指令版模型中存在与人类矩阵对齐的几何结构，但在基础版模型中该测试下对齐度很低。在所有模型中，几何强度与行为放大程度相关（r = 0.68，p = 0.008；控制日志大小后的偏相关r = 0.69）。为将内部结构与输出行为关联，采用匹配激活探测范式，发现探测斜率的变化小于行为斜率（1.38–1.77 vs 0.52–1.53）。合成对照显示，岭探测可夸大这些斜率；在减去基于另一分析中可靠性代理的基线后，调整后的斜率仍与行为相关（r = 0.88）。我们称测得的探测-行为差距为读出衰减。这些结果在测试范式下建立了可解码性和几何对齐性，但未证明所测方向中介了跨人物回答。

summary: Social media platforms are a primary source of information for many users. Although research explores various interventions to promote prosocial content or demote harmful content on platforms, there are few systematic methods for evaluating competing intervention designs before conducting costly human-subject experiments. We develop a simulation-based evaluation pipeline built on the OASIS framework. We generate 13,835 LLM-based agents, each with a unique profile. Over 20 time steps, we expose them to real-world Twitter/X posts and let them comment, like, repost, or follow. We use those agents to systematically evaluate three interventions that increase exposure to verified news: adding content, upranking content, and celebrity source cues. All interventions significantly increase news engagement, with upranking news to prominent feed positions producing the largest effects. These effects hold across agents' gender, age, and education levels. We validate our injection treatment results against a comparable human-subject study and find strong directional alignment and similar dose-normalized efficiency. Our results suggest that LLM-based agent simulations can support early-stage evaluation of platform interventions before human-subject deployment, and upranking may be more effective than news volume or source.
title: Using LLM Agents to Evaluate Prosocial Interventions on Social Media Platforms
title_translated: 使用大语言模型智能体评估社交媒体平台上的亲社会干预措施
summary_translated: 社交媒体平台是许多用户获取信息的主要来源。尽管已有研究探索了多种促进亲社会内容或降低有害内容的干预方法，但在开展成本高昂的人类受试者实验之前，缺乏系统性的方法来评估不同干预设计的效果。我们基于OASIS框架构建了一个基于仿真的评估流程。我们生成了13,835个具有独特个人特征的大语言模型智能体，在20个时间步中，让它们接触真实的推特/X帖子，并进行评论、点赞、转发或关注。利用这些智能体系统性地评估了三种增加可信新闻曝光度的干预措施：添加内容、提升内容排名以及引入名人来源提示。所有干预措施均显著提升了新闻互动率，其中将新闻提升至信息流显著位置的效果最为明显。这一结果在不同性别、年龄和教育水平的智能体中均保持一致。我们将模拟结果与一项类似的人类受试者研究进行对比，发现两者在方向上高度一致，且剂量归一化效率相近。结果表明，基于大语言模型的智能体仿真可在人类受试者部署前支持平台干预措施的早期评估，且提升排名可能比单纯增加新闻数量或改变来源更有效。

summary: Multimodal humor detection requires interpreting language, vocal delivery, and visual behavior jointly. Expressive fusion must also regulate how interactions of different orders enter the final judgment. We propose Möbius Interaction Filtering (MoIF), which learns a modality-subset prediction function and imposes order-selective spectral regularization through its aggregation structure. Private temporal encoders and balanced reciprocal interaction construct supervised unimodal, bimodal, and trimodal predictors. Their uniform aggregate is exactly a Möbius-domain filter with a geometrically decreasing interaction-order response. This formulation retains higher-order representations while regulating their contribution to prediction. Controlled UR-FUNNY perturbations reveal a pronounced decline in label-aligned signal-to-noise ratio across interaction orders. The induced filter improves the final ratio by 1.62-2.79 times relative to the co-trained trimodal predictor while preserving its own clean class-aligned signal under perturbation. Five-seed experiments achieve 70.6% accuracy and weighted F1 on UR-FUNNY, exceeding thirteen reproduced methods on these detection metrics. CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI evaluations establish applicability to sentiment prediction, and cross-seed analyses show more stable estimates on all three datasets. MoIF connects the organization of multimodal interactions to their statistical reliability through an executable spectral constraint. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/MoIF.
title: Möbius Interaction Filtering: Order-Selective Spectral Regularization for Multimodal Humor Detection

title_translated: 莫比乌斯交互过滤：用于多模态幽默检测的顺序选择谱正则化
summary_translated: 多模态幽默检测需要联合解析语言、语音表达和视觉行为。同时，融合过程必须调控不同阶次交互信息如何进入最终判断。我们提出莫比乌斯交互过滤（MoIF），通过其聚合结构学习一个模态子集预测函数，并施加顺序选择性的谱正则化。采用私有的时序编码器和平衡的相互作用结构，构建监督的单模态、双模态和三模态预测器。它们的统一聚合恰好构成一个莫比乌斯域滤波器，具有几何递减的交互阶次响应特性。该形式在保留高阶表示的同时，调节其对预测的贡献。受控的UR-FUNNY扰动实验揭示了不同交互阶次间标签对齐信噪比的显著下降。所诱导的滤波器使最终信噪比相比联合训练的三模态预测器提高了1.62至2.79倍，同时在扰动下仍保持自身干净的类别对齐信号。五种子实验在UR-FUNNY数据集上达到70.6%的准确率和加权F1，超越了十三种复现方法。CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI的评估验证了其在情感预测中的适用性，跨种子分析显示在三个数据集上估计更加稳定。MoIF通过可执行的谱约束，将多模态交互的组织方式与其统计可靠性联系起来。代码已开源：https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/MoIF。
